title: Audio / Mixing Engineer Needed
description:
About Us:



We are a music agency specializing in live events and studio productions. Our work spans from high-energy live performances to professional in-studio content, requiring top-tier audio production quality.



Required Technical Setup:



A Quality DAW (Pro Tools, Studio One, Logic, Ableton) - we cannot hire someone who uses Reaper

A Powerful Enough computer to handle large audio projects

Vocal Tuning: Melodyne - if you do not have Melodyne Assistant, we can give you access to the one that we have with our company. 

Quality Plugins (example: quality compressors like CLA76, Fabfilter EQ, SoundToys, mastering plugins like Ozone)



*Note: Equivalent quality plugins will be considered, but familiarity with these industry standards is preferred.



Key Responsibilities:



- Mix and master live performance recordings

- Ability to download large audio files (we will send you these)

- Melodyne vocals in a way that sounds organic and natural

- Create templates for or bands and artists for speedier workflows

- Ensure consistent sound quality across all productions

- Collaborate with our video team for synchronized content



Required Qualifications:



- MOST IMPORTANT: You must be a musician or have a strong understanding of music theory. The most time consuming part of this position is tuning vocals, and you'll need to know music theory in order to ensure that lead vocals and harmony vocals are accurate.

- Minimum 3 years experience with Pro Tools (or a similar DAW)

- Proven experience in professional audio mixing and mastering

- Deep understanding of plugin chains and signal processing

- Experience with multi-track mixing

- Strong ear for detail and musical balance

- Portfolio demonstrating professional mixing work



To Apply, please submit:



- Your portfolio of mixed/mastered tracks

- Resume highlighting relevant experience

- List of your current plugin collection

- Description of your mixing environment

- Examples of live music mixing if available



This position offers:



- Flexible remote work arrangements

- Growing project volume

- Professional development potential

- Possible transition to full-time role



Join our team and help shape the sound of our productions while working with diverse musical talent. We look forward to hearing your work and potentially welcoming you to our creative family.

title: Senior Graphic Designer — Billboard
description:
# Senior Graphic Designer — Billboard / Out-of-Home (Print & Digital Production)



 Project-based to start (45+ billboard designs), with ongoing work for the right person



---



 We need an experienced large-format / out-of-home (OOH) designer to turn our brand templates and approved copy into print-ready and digital-ready billboard artwork for a multi-board campaign thanking U.S. members of Congress — about **15 officials × 3 message variations = 45+ boards** — plus ongoing campaigns after this one.



You will take our existing concepts, brand colors (navy/gold), copy, and portrait photos and build **vendor-ready files for Lamar, Clear Channel Outdoor, and OUTFRONT**. This is real print-production work — not social media graphics — so you must understand building at scale, CMYK, bleed/safety areas, and how to package files to a vendor spec sheet.



## What you'll do



- Design and produce **14? × 48? static bulletin** and **digital bulletin** artwork from our brand template and copy.

- Build every file to the **exact vendor spec sheet** (size, scale, resolution, color mode, bleed, safety area) for Lamar / Clear Channel Outdoor / OUTFRONT.

- Professionally **cut out / mask portrait photos** (clean edges on hair and shoulders) and composite them onto brand backgrounds.

- Maintain a **consistent template system** across 45+ variations using master files, smart objects, and styles.

- Apply OOH best practices: short readable copy (?7 words), large legible type, high contrast, correct legal disclaimer placement.

- Prepare **print-ready packaged files** (CMYK, outlined fonts, embedded/linked images, PDF/X export) and **RGB digital JPGs**.

- Source or recommend **high-resolution photography** where our supplied images are too small for print.

- Handle revisions, proofs, and "overage" copy; hit vendor deadlines (copy is typically due ~10 working days before a board runs).



## Required skills & experience



- **3+ years** professional graphic design with **real large-format / OOH / billboard or print-production experience** (portfolio required).

- **Expert in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop** (InDesign a plus).

- Strong **typography and layout** — you understand legibility at distance.

- Professional **photo cutout / masking / retouching**.

- Solid **print production** knowledge: CMYK, resolution-at-scale (building 1 inch = 1 foot), bleed & safety area, rich black, packaging files, and PDF/X export.

- Understanding of **digital OOH** requirements: RGB, exact pixel dimensions, static-only (no animation).

- **High attention to detail** and the discipline to follow exact spec sheets.

- **Good written English** and responsive, reliable communication.



## Bonus points



- Experience with **U.S. political / advocacy / issue advertising**.

- Experience working directly to **Lamar / Clear Channel Outdoor / OUTFRONT** specs.

- Comfort **sourcing and licensing high-resolution stock or photography**.

- Basic **motion / DOOH** skills (a plus, not required).



## Tools you'll need



- Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator + Photoshop required; InDesign a plus)

- Reliable internet and computer capable of handling large print files

- File sharing (Google Drive / Dropbox)



## Reference — the specs you'll build to



| | Static 14?×48? bulletin | Digital bulletin |

|---|---|---|

| Build scale | 1 inch = 1 foot | Pixel-exact |

| File size | ~49? × 15? trim (1? bleed); 48? × 14? live/safety | 1400 × 400 px (varies per board) |

| Resolution | 150 ppi at scaled size | 72 dpi |

| Color mode | CMYK | sRGB / RGB |

| Format | High-res packaged PDF, fonts outlined | High-res JPG |

| Motion | n/a | Static only, no animation |



*(Exact specs vary by board — you must read and follow each vendor's individual spec sheet.)*



---



## How to apply — please read carefully (we filter applications)



1. **Start your message with the word "BULLETIN"** so we know you read the full post.

2. Send your **portfolio link**, and point us to any **billboard / large-format / OOH / print** work specifically.

3. In 2–3 sentences, explain **the difference between preparing a static 14×48 bulletin file vs. a digital bulletin file** (think color mode, scale/resolution, format).

4. Tell us your **availability** and your **rate** (and whether you prefer hourly, monthly, or per-board).



Applications that skip these steps will not be reviewed.



## Paid test (shortlisted candidates only)



We'll invite finalists to a **small paid test**: using a portrait, copy, and brand colors we provide, deliver —

- **(a)** a print-ready **14? × 48? bulletin** built at 1 inch = 1 foot, **150 ppi, CMYK**, with 1? bleed and a correct 48?×14? safety area, exported as a packaged print **PDF**; and

- **(b)** a **1400 × 400 px, sRGB digital bulletin JPG** of the same design.



We pay for the test and review the files for spec accuracy, type legibility, and clean photo cutouts.

title: Full-Time Home Care Scheduling Coordinator
description:
Job Description:

We are a home care agency looking for an experienced, dependable, full-time Scheduling Coordinator. This is a long-term role for someone who can take ownership of caregiver scheduling, client communication, and urgent schedule changes.

This is not a simple data-entry position. We need someone calm, responsible, organized, and accountable who can manage competing priorities, communicate clearly by phone and message, and follow through until scheduling issues are resolved.

You will work closely with our Operations Manager and will help ensure that clients receive reliable care, caregivers have accurate schedules, and all schedule changes are documented properly in our operating system.



Main Responsibilities:

Manage caregiver schedules and schedule changes in "eRSP Software System"

Communicate schedule updates to caregivers, clients, family contacts, and internal tea
mbers.

Respond quickly and professionally to call-outs, missed shifts, open shifts, and last-minute schedule changes.

Help resolve scheduling conflicts while keeping the Operations Manager informed.

Maintain accurate notes on clients, caregivers, availability, call-outs, and schedule changes.

Answer incoming calls and assist with client/caregiver communication as needed.

Follow established procedures for documentation, escalation, and shift coverage.

Provide clear handoff notes at the end of each shift.

Protect client and caregiver confidentiality at all times.



Must-Have Experience:

Prior experience in scheduling, staffing coordination, dispatch, care coordination, healthcare administration, or home care operations.

Excellent spoken and written English.

Strong phone communication skills and professional telephone etiquette.

Ability to stay calm under pressure and manage urgent situations.

Strong attention to detail and accurate documentation habits.

Ability to work independently without constant supervision.

Reliable computer, quiet workspace, strong internet connection, and backup internet option.

Comfort using web-based software, VoIP phones,
, chat, and shared documents.



Preferred Experience:

Experience with eRSP home care scheduling software.

Experience scheduling caregivers, nurses, CNAs, home health aides, or field staff.

Experience working US business hours or overnight Philippines time.

Experience communicating with elderly clients, family members, caregivers, and office staff.



The Right Person for This Role:

You are accountable and do not disappear when things get stressful.

You communicate early when there is a problem.

You document carefully so the rest of the team knows what happened.

You can handle multiple schedule changes without becoming disorganized.

You are polite but firm when needed.

You understand that a missed shift affects a real client who depends on care.

You take pride in keeping the schedule accurate and covered.



Not a Good Fit If:

You need constant reminders to complete tasks.

You avoid phone calls.

You become overwhelmed by urgent changes.

You do not like documenting details.

You cannot reliably work the agreed schedule.

You are looking for short-term or part-time work.



Schedule:

Full-time, 40 hours per week.

Must be able to work 8:30am - 5pm US Eastern Time Zone

Some weekend or holiday coverage may be required depending on business needs.

Please do not apply unless you can consistently work these hours.

title: Executive Assistant — U.S. Music Agency
description:
Hi! 



Crowd Theory Entertainment is a U.S.-based live music and entertainment agency specializing in entertainment for weddings, corporate events, private parties, and luxury celebrations.



We book and manage:



* Live bands

* DJs

* Singers

* Instrumentalists

* Specialty performers

* Full entertainment teams for high-end events



We work closely with clients, event planners, musicians, and vendors to deliver polished, high-quality live entertainment experiences.



We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Executive Assistant to join our team full-time and support our daily operations.



Position Details



* Position: Executive Assistant

* Type: Full-time

* Hours: 40 hours per week

* Schedule: Pacific Time business hours

* Location: Remote

* Starting Pay: $8.50 USD per hour, approximately $1,500 USD per month

* Growth: 90-day performance review, with opportunities for pay increases based on performance; annual compensation reviews thereafter



Main Responsibilities



You will help our team with client communication, booking workflows, contractor coordination, and general administrative support.



Responsibilities include:



* Responding to client
s in a clear, professional, and helpful manner

* Sending contracts, invoices, and certificates of insurance when requested by clients

* Completing booking workflows when one of our artists is booked

* Crewing our bands and musicians through our scheduling software

* Checking client payment statuses for upcoming events

* Responding to musician inquiries by

* Using provided FAQs, templates, and AI assistant support to answer common questions

* Onboarding new contractors through our simple onboarding system

* Assisting company leadership with administrative, operational, and client-service tasks

* Helping keep internal systems organized and up to date



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who is organized, dependable, communicative, and comfortable learning new systems.



The ideal candidate has:



* Excellent written English

* Excellent conversational English

* Professional
 communication skills

* Strong attention to detail

* Good organizational skills

* Ability to follow written processes carefully

* Comfort working with online software tools

* A reliable internet connection

* A quiet work environment

* Availability to work Pacific Time business hours

* A positive, calm, and solution-oriented communication style

* A background in music is helpful, but not required



We will conduct a performance review after the first 90 days. Based on reliability, communication, accuracy, attention to detail, and overall performance, there may be an opportunity for a pay increase at that time.



After the initial 90-day review, compensation will be reviewed annually, with additional opportunities for raises and advancement based on consistent performance and growth within the role.



Why Join Us



This is a long-term opportunity with a growing creative company. You will learn our systems, support meaningful client and musician communication, and become an important part of our operations team.



We are looking for someone who wants stability, growth, and the opportunity to build a strong role within our company over time.



How to Apply



Please send:



* A brief introduction about yourself

* Your relevant work experience

* Your availability to work Pacific Time business hours

* Your current monthly compensation

* A short explanation of why you think you would be a strong fit for this role

* Any relevant examples of client communication, admin work, or operations experience



Talk with you soon!

title: Executive Assistant (Remote – Philippines)
description:
Company: SunSent Solar & Roofing

Location: Remote (Philippines-based applicants only)

Employment Type: Full-time, Independent Contractor



About SunSent Solar & Roofing



SunSent Solar & Roofing is a fast-growing solar and roofing company serving Missouri and surrounding areas. We're building a lean, high-performing team that runs on the EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System): clear priorities, clear ownership, and disciplined execution. We're looking for a Senior Executive Assistant who can keep pace with a company that moves fast, values accountability, and operates with a high standard of excellence.



About the Role



We're hiring a Senior Executive Assistant to provide high-level support to our leadership team. This is not an entry-level administrative role—we're looking for someone who has successfully supported senior executives, can operate independently under pressure, and isn't afraid to raise concerns or recommend better ways of doing things.



Experience in the solar or roofing industry is a strong advantage, and familiarity with US-based hiring and onboarding processes will set you apart.



Key Responsibilities



•Provide executive-level support to company leadership by managing calendars, communications, scheduling, travel arrangements, and priorities.

•Coordinate and assist with the recruitment, hiring, and onboarding of US-based employees and contractors.

•Support daily business operations using CRM platforms and internal systems while quickly learning new software as needed.

•Help drive execution of leadership priorities, including EOS Rocks, To-Dos, meeting follow-ups, and action items.

•Prepare meeting agendas, reports, presentations, and executive documentation.

•Handle confidential and time-sensitive information with professionalism, discretion, urgency, and accuracy.

•Anticipate executive and operational needs, identify issues before they become problems, and proactively recommend solutions.

•Coordinate projects and communication across a distributed US and Philippine workforce.

•Ensure leadership remains organized, informed, and focused on high-impact priorities.



Qualifications



•Minimum of 3 years of Executive Assistant experience, preferably supporting senior executives, founders, or C-level leadership.

•Strong sense of urgency and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

•Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to catch inconsistencies and errors others may overlook.

•Proven ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and professionalism under pressure.

•Highly organized with outstanding time management and follow-through.

•Tech-savvy and resourceful, with the ability to quickly learn CRMs and new software platforms with minimal guidance.

•Experience in the solar and/or roofing industry is strongly preferred.

•Experience working within the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) is highly preferred.

•Previous experience supporting US-based recruitment, hiring, and onboarding processes is preferred.

•Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

* Confident enough to raise concerns, provide recommendations, and respectfully push back when appropriate—not simply execute assigned tasks.



What We're Looking For (Character Fit)



•Takes ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do.

•Proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented.

•Comfortable working directly with US leadership across multiple time zones.

•Trustworthy, dependable, and able to handle confidential information with discretion.

•Calm under pressure and adaptable to changing priorities.

•Committed to continuous improvement and operational excellence.

•A genuine problem-solver who looks beyond completing tasks to improving outcomes.



Work Setup



•Fully remote (Philippines-based applicants only).

•Full-time Independent Contractor.

•Must be available to work during US Central Time business hours.

•Must have a reliable desktop or laptop (dual monitors preferred).

•Stable high-speed internet connection with a backup internet option is highly preferred.

•Quiet, professional home office suitable for virtual meetings.



Compensation & Benefits



•USD $1,200–$1,440 per month (approximately PHP 72,000–PHP 86,400 per month), based on experience and qualifications.

•Paid weekly via Wise.

•HMO coverage after 60 days of continuous service.

•Paid training and structured onboarding.

•Opportunity for long-term career growth within a rapidly growing US-based solar and roofing company.

•Work closely with an experienced leadership team committed to operational excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.



How to Apply



To apply, please submit the following through OnlineJobs.ph:



•Your updated resume.

•A short message describing your Executive Assistant experience.

•A brief summary of your experience supporting U.S.-based companies or remote teams.

•A brief summary of any experience you have in the roofing and/or solar industry and your experience working in an EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) environment, if applicable.

•Complete our Culture Index survey as part of your application:





Applications that do not include the required information and completed Culture Index survey may not be considered.



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Appointment Setter – AI Lead Gen for Home Services (Base + Commission)
description:
ATTENTION: Appointment Setters Who Are Hungry, Consistent, and Great on the Phone



We're an established and growing US marketing agency looking for a dedicated appointment setter who works both inbound and outbound leads. Not a dabbler. Not someone who ghosts their pipeline. A professional who takes pride in booking qualified meetings - every single day.



If you've hit consistent daily activity targets, kept a clean CRM, and love the feeling of getting a prospect to say "yes, book me in" - keep reading. If you're looking to coast, this isn't your role.



What You'll Be Setting Appointments For:

An AI-powered lead generation system built for Home Services businesses (painters, remodelers, and similar trades). The system generates leads, qualifies them with AI voice + text agents, and books appointments directly on our clients' calendars. It works. We took one painter from $295K/year to $1.5M in 14 months. We have killer case studies, a product that delivers, and a closer who converts.



The Reality of This Role:

This is consistent, focused work. You'll be working warm inbound leads AND running outbound to home services business owners. Your one job: get qualified decision-makers on the calendar. A closer handles the rest. Most people don't have the discipline for this. The ones who do will earn well and grow with us.



Your Mission:

- Work inbound leads fast - speed to lead is everything.

- Run outbound to home services business owners (phone + text + LinkedIn).

- Qualify prospects and book them onto the closer's calendar using GHL.

- Keep the pipeline clean and updated - no leads left behind.

- Hit your daily booked-meeting targets. Then beat them.



Who We're Looking For:

- Consistent and disciplined - you show up, dial, and hit targets without being chased.

- Phone confidence - comfortable starting conversations with business owners cold.

- 1+ year of appointment setting or outbound prospecting experience (proven results, not just "experience")

- Excellent written and spoken English

- A self-starter who manages their own activity without hand-holding

- Hungry - you want to earn commission on every meeting that closes



Bonus Points If You Have:

- Set appointments for home services / trades / local business owners

- Worked for a digital/marketing agency or B2B service business

- Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL)

- Comfortable with SMS/text and
 outreach alongside phone calls

- AI tools in your daily workflow (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.)



You must be able to work US business hours (8am–5pm HST / 11pm–8am PHT). This is a firm requirement - not flexible.



Employment:

Part-time or full-time (40 hrs/week), long-term only. We're not interested in job-hoppers.



Compensation:

Uncapped commission. Base starting 30k-50k PHP/month + commission per closed deal that you set + residual recurring commission (Wise/Payoneer paid bi-weekly). Top setters double their base monthly when the closer converts. 13th month considered for long-term hires.



HOW TO APPLY (FOLLOW EXACTLY - IF YOU CAN'T FOLLOW DIRECTIONS, YOU CAN'T BOOK FOR US)



- Use 7 apply points.

-
 subject must start with "SDR777" and include your name.

- Number your answers 1–7 as outlined below.



1) How many outbound dials per day are you comfortable making?

2) Are you a setter, a closer, or both? Be honest.

3) How many meetings have you personally booked? Give us real numbers (meetings set, show rate, deal outcomes if known).

4) Why should we pick you over every other applicant? Sell us on you as a setter.

5) Your DISC score in the format D _ / I _ / S _ / C _ (required). If it's been more than 2 years since you took it, retake it in your OnlineJobs dashboard.

6) Your PHP monthly base rate + commission expectations + earliest start date.

7) Record a 2-5 minute video introducing yourself and selling us on why you're the right person for this role, include the link in your application. No video, no review.



Applications without all items above and proper subject won't be opened.



We're looking for someone who takes pride in filling calendars. If that's you, we want to hear from you.

title: Outbound Marketing Owner
description:
We're a U.S. recruiting / RPO business serving manufacturing leaders, and we're looking for someone to own our outbound marketing end to end — not run a script we hand you, but build, drive, and improve the entire engine that turns a list of target companies into booked conversations.



This is a role for an owner, not an executor. We'll point you at our market (~1,500 priority manufacturing accounts) and the outcome we want (real conversations with decision-makers), and you bring the strategy, the tools, and the judgment to get there. If you need to be told each step, this isn't for you. If you've been wanting full ownership of an outreach function — and a direct line between your performance and your pay — keep reading.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN:



The whole outbound engine — strategy, targeting, messaging, channels, and execution. You own the number: booked meetings with qualified decision-makers.



Strategy & ideas — you're expected to bring new tools, channels, and angles to the table, test them, and tell us what's working. We want to learn from you, not just direct you.



Targeted research & personalization — we're quality-over-volume (~100 deeply-researched leads/week against our priority accounts, each with a real, specific hook), not mass-blasting. You know how to find the signal that earns a reply.



Campaign execution — build and run sequences (we use Instantly; open to your recommendations), test relentlessly, and optimize toward replies and meetings, not send volume.



The technical backend — still extremely important and non-negotiable. You own deliverability: sending domains, mailboxes, DNS (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, custom tracking domains), warmup, rotation, and inbox-health monitoring. Setup is front-loaded; keeping placement high is ongoing. If the
s don't hit the inbox, nothing else matters.



Tooling — Apollo, Clay / Claygent, verification, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and whatever else you can justify. Recommend the stack; we'll resource what works.



WHO YOU ARE:



- You've owned outbound or lead-gen before and can point to meetings or deals you drove — not just campaigns you ran.

- Confident you can land conversations, and comfortable being measured on it.

- A builder and problem-solver who brings ideas rather than waiting for instructions.

- Deep on
 infrastructure and deliverability (SPF/DKIM/DMARC, warmup, 2024+ Google/Yahoo sender rules) — a hard requirement.

- Strong with modern outbound tooling (Apollo, Clay, Instantly / Smartlead) and quick to evaluate new ones.

- Fluent written English, sharp judgment, and genuine attention to detail.



COMPENSATION:



$5–10 / hour USD to start, depending on experience — part-time initially. This is a starting point: strong performance moves you up — more hours, a higher base rate, and bigger upside on every meeting and deal you drive.



Booked-meeting bonuses:

- Meetings 1–20: $20 each

- Meetings 21–40: $30 each

- Meetings 41+: $40 each (cap)



Deal bonuses — once you've hit the meeting cap, you earn on outcomes: $100–$500 per deal that converts into a completed search, scaled by deal size.



A "qualified meeting" = a target decision-maker (VP / Director of Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Plant Manager, President / COO) who attends a genuine fit conversation. No-shows and unqualified contacts don't count.



HOW TO APPLY:



Send the following:

1. A short note on how you'd approach owning outbound for a recruiting business targeting manufacturers — your angle, your first moves, and the tools you'd reach for.

2. A specific result you've personally driven (meetings or deals), with rough numbers.

3. Screenshots from Instantly / Smartlead showing your reply rates and inbox health.

4. Your answer to: what's the difference between DMARC p=none, p=quarantine, and p=reject, and which do you use during warmup?

5. Your rate and availability.



Generic applications won't be considered. We're looking for an owner — show us how you think.

s and messages when needed

title: Video Editor
description:
Video Editor 



Video is how we reach the moms who need us. We film the footage. We need someone who can turn that footage into sharp, scroll-stopping content that holds our standard every single time. This role lives inside our marketing engine, working directly with our Director of Marketing across paid ads, long-form YouTube, and eventually organic social.



Please make sure you read the job description in its entirety. There are instructions below on how to complete your application. If you do not follow the steps and send an
 with requested documentation to 
 , your application will not be considered. 



Role Mission

This role exists to take the raw footage we film and cut it into polished, on-brand video that performs. You won't be filming. You'll be editing, and you'll be editing a lot. To start, the work is mostly paid ads built for multiple platforms, plus some long-form YouTube. As we grow, this expands into organic content too. Your job is to make every cut land at our golden standard, fast, with minimal back and forth. If you're a great editor who takes direction well and moves quickly, this is a long-term seat.



Who We Are Looking For



We're looking for a genuinely strong editor, not someone learning on our footage. You probably are:

A fast, precise editor who can match a defined style and hit it consistently.

Fluent in at least one professional editing suite and comfortable picking up others.

A clear spoken English communicator who can take notes and direction without confusion.

Someone who treats a brief seriously and delivers close to right on the first pass.

Reliable, responsive, and able to manage an ongoing workload without hand-holding.

Comfortable with paid ad editing and the pacing that platform content demands.

You probably are not the right fit if you need heavy supervision, miss deadlines, or struggle to communicate clearly in English.



Responsibilities & Expectations

This role reports to and takes direction directly from Autumn, our Director of Marketing.

Paid Ad Editing (Primary, To Start)

Cut paid ad creative from supplied footage for multiple platforms.

Format and resize for each platform's specs and aspect ratios.

Hold our golden standard on pacing, captions, branding, and polish across every deliverable.

Long-Form Editing

Edit long-form YouTube content from supplied footage.

Structure cuts for retention: clean intros, tight pacing, clear payoff.

Organic Content (As We Grow)

Edit short-form organic social content as the role expands beyond ads.

Stay current on format trends so our organic content feels native to each platform.

Workflow & Communication

Take footage, briefs and revision notes from Autumn and turn them around quickly.

Keep communication clear and prompt. Some overlap with US working hours is preferred. Async is workable.



Required Experience & Skills

Must Have (Non-Negotiable)

Proven editing skill with a portfolio or reel that demonstrates it.

Proficiency in at least one professional suite: Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or DaVinci Resolve.

Clear spoken and written English.

Experience editing for paid ads, organic short-form platform content and long form video.

Reliable internet, hardware, and availability for ongoing full-time work.

Strongly Preferred

Multi-platform formatting experience across paid social.

Motion graphics and basic title or caption design.

Long-form YouTube editing experience.

Experience editing organic short-form content.

Familiarity with health, wellness, or maternal content.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

| KPI | Target |

| Turnaround time per ad cut | Within agreed deadline, no chasing |

| Revision rounds per deliverable | Two or fewer |

| First-pass adherence to golden standard | 90 percent or higher |

| Deliverables shipped per week | Scales with workload, met consistently |

| Communication responsiveness | Replies within one business day |

| Platform formatting accuracy | Correct specs every time, zero rework |









-Benefits & Perks

Pay rate: 10 USD per hour.

Ongoing 1099 contract with full-time hours preferred. Workload scales with our needs.

Fully remote, Philippines-based.

Direct working relationship with our Director of Marketing.

Real growth path as our video output expands from ads into organic and beyond.



: 
 Subject line: “Video Editor with The Latchlink"

Please include: 

Video (instructions below)

Resume 

Portfolio

Send us a short video (2 to 3 minutes) answering these four questions:

Who are you and what is your experience as a video editor?

Why The Latchlink?



Bonus Information

This is a 1099 contractor role, not an employee position. It does not include W-2 benefits.

Based in the Philippines. Some overlap with US working hours is preferred, but async is workable.

We're hiring with urgency. We want the right person in this seat soon.

The role starts heavy on paid ads and long-form, then grows into organic content over time.

title: Facebook/Meta Media Buyer — B2C Patient Lead Generation (Full-Time, Long-Term, Remote)
description:
Read every word. The application steps at the bottom are the first test. Miss them and you are not considered. Attention to detail is the entire job.

We are an established, profitable US marketing agency in the health and wellness space. We run
 and Instagram campaigns that get patients to book consultations for regenerative medicine treatments (joint pain, orthopedic, and related conditions) at medical clinics across America. We are hiring one skilled B2C Media Buyer to own and scale these patient-acquisition campaigns.

This is a performance role. You will be judged on one thing: do the campaigns you manage produce qualified patient leads and booked consultations at a profitable cost, at volume. If you love the daily craft of high-volume testing, reading data, and scaling what works, this is for you.

About us (so you know we're real and stable)

We're a fast-growing, profitable US agency with proven funnels, a creative team, a media buying mentor, and winning ad accounts across many clinics. You step into a machine that works, not a blank page. We pay on time, every time, via Wise, PayPal, or bank transfer. We hire for the long term and grow the people who perform. Our team will share our company site and a live funnel example.

What you will own day to day



Build, launch, and manage high-volume B2C patient-acquisition campaigns across many clinic ad accounts

Optimize daily toward our key metric: cost per qualified booked patient consultation

Manage budgets across multiple accounts, scale winning ad sets, kill losers fast, control frequency on cold audiences

Build and manage custom audiences, lookalikes, retargeting layers, and exclusions for patient audiences (older, pain-motivated demographics)

QA campaign structure, ad sets, and tracking before every launch

Read the data and report clearly: cost per lead, cost per booking, cost per qualified show, CTR, CPM, landing page conversion

Combat ad fatigue across many local markets with organized creative testing

Work directly with our creative team and founder on what to test next



Hard skills you must already have (rate yourself 1-10 on each in your application)



Hands-on
/Instagram Ads Manager experience managing real budgets

B2C lead-generation experience — high-volume consumer lead gen, ideally local-service or health/wellness (not e-commerce only)

Custom audiences, lookalikes, retargeting, and exclusion setup

Managing multiple ad accounts and fighting ad fatigue across local markets

Reading and acting on performance data — you d
 from numbers, not feelings

Comfort with Meta Pixel / Conversions API concepts and campaign QA

Bonus: health, wellness, medical, or other restricted-vertical experience; GoHighLevel (GHL) familiarity



Soft skills we need (tell us about yourself on these)



Deadline-driven and reliable — you show up and follow through

Analytical and detail-obsessed — small ad-account errors cost real money and you know it

Self-starter who takes ownership instead of waiting to be told

Calm under pressure and organized across many accounts at once

Clear communicator who can explain what's happening and why



The offer (clear, because you deserve straight answers)



Salary: $1,000-$2,000 USD/month, based on proven skill. Top of the range is real and reserved for buyers who can show past B2C volume results.

Full-time, long-term. Overlap with US business hours required (confirmed together).

100% remote, work from home.

Paid on time, every time, via Wise / PayPal / bank transfer.

Real growth path: as we scale, the person who owns B2C media buying grows in pay, scope, and title.

You inherit a machine that works — mentor, funnels, creative, winning accounts.



Our commitment (risk reversal both ways)

We start with a paid test project — never free work. You'll walk us through how you'd approach a real patient-acquisition scenario we describe. Do it well and you move to a paid trial period with close feedback and support. You'll never do unpaid work and never be left guessing whether you're on track.

HOW TO APPLY — follow exactly



Start your application with the exact phrase: "Cost per booking is king." Anything without this at the very top is deleted unread.

In 3-4 sentences, describe one high-volume B2C lead-gen campaign you managed — the platform, budget, and result (any real metric).

List your fluency (1-10) in:
 Ads Manager, B2C/local lead-gen, custom audiences/lookalikes, managing multiple accounts, reading performance data.

Answer in one short paragraph: "A patient campaign's cost per booked consultation doubled over the last week with no budget change. What are the first 3 things you check?"

Send a link to your OnlineJobs.ph profile and note any health/wellness, medical, or local-service lead-gen experience.



We read every application that follows these steps. We hire on demonstrated skill, not resumes.

title: Marketing Director & Social Media Manager (PT growing to FT)
description:
Practivo AI (practivo.ai) is a done-for-you AI automation agency serving personal injury law firms across the United States. We build and manage the backend systems that help PI firms respond to leads faster, keep clients informed, track medical records, and move cases to settlement, without adding additional staff. 



We're a founder-led company in active growth mode, signing our first clients now. This is not a company that needs someone to post motivational quotes and hope for the best. We operate in a specialized, relationship-driven niche called personal injury law. Our marketing needs to be sharp, credible, and consistent with the voice of a company that understands how these firms actually work.



The Role:



We are looking for a part-time Marketing Director and Social Media Manager to own Practivo's entire external marketing presence. You will report directly to the founder, operate with significant autonomy, and be accountable for making sure Practivo shows up professionally, consistently, and strategically everywhere a potential client might look.



This role starts with organic content and platform management, and will expand into paid advertising...specifically Meta 
/Instagram) ads targeting PI law firm owners. We need someone who can do both: execute what's in front of them now and be ready to build and manage paid campaigns when the time comes.



What You Will Own/Do:



LinkedIn — Personal Profile + Company Page



- Develop and manage a weekly content calendar aligned to our content framework

- Draft 2 posts per week (Tuesday and Thursday) in the founder's voice for her personal profile.  She reviews and approves before anything goes live

- Manage the Practivo AI company page: mirror key posts, maintain consistent branding, keep it active

- Monitor comments and engagement, flag anything that needs a response from the founder

- Track performance metrics weekly (reach, impressions, engagement, follower growth)



Google Business Profile



- Post weekly updates to the Practivo AI Google Business Profile

- Monitor and respond to reviews (draft responses for founder approval)

- Proactively request reviews from clients and contacts as directed

- Ensure business information, hours, and service descriptions are current and accurate



Meta Ads — Preparation Now, Activation When Ready



- Build audience research, ad creative briefs, and campaign frameworks for Meta 
/Instagram) ads targeting PI law firm owners and managing partners — so we are ready to launch when the timing is right

- When campaigns go
 set up, manage, and optimize paid Meta campaigns inside GoHighLevel or Meta Ads Manager

- Create ad creative in Canva (static and carousel) aligned to brand guidelines

- Monitor ad spend, performance metrics (CPL, CTR, ROAS), and report weekly

- Test and iterate on audiences, copy, and creative based on performance data



Content Calendar & Brand Consistency



- Maintain a master content calendar across all active channels (using AI is encouraged)

- Ensure every piece of content — LinkedIn, GBP, Meta ads,
, and marketing assets, is consistent with Practivo brand guidelines (specific colors, fonts, and tone)

- Create and manage branded Canva templates for post graphics and ad creatives

- Repurpose long-form content (playbooks, checklists, research) into shorter-form social and ad content



Campaign & Outreach Asset Support



- Draft content for referral partner campaign materials and follow-up sequences

- Support lead magnet assets, content updates to the PI Workflow Leak Checklist and the PI Intake Leak Calculator landing page

- Assist with copy for direct mail pieces and marketing collateral as needed

- Collaborate with the web developer on landing page content and calls to action



Reporting



- Deliver a weekly marketing summary every Friday: what went out, what got engagement, what needs attention, what's planned for next week

- Track performance against defined KPIs and flag underperformance early with a recommendation

- As paid ads launch, provide weekly ad performance breakdowns with spend, results, and optimization notes



Who You Are :) 



Required:



- Excellent written English - professional American business voice. Clear, direct, and credible. Not corporate and stiff. Not casual and sloppy.

- Demonstrated experience managing LinkedIn for a business or executive brand: B2B professional content, not personal social media

- Experience managing Google Business Profile or similar business listing platforms

- Hands-on experience running Meta 
/Instagram) paid ad campaigns.  You have set up campaigns, managed budgets, and optimized based on performance data. This is not a "I've boosted a post" answer. We need someone who has worked inside Ads Manager.

- Organized, deadline-driven, and able to manage multiple channels and a content calendar without being chased

- Proficient in Canva for professional graphic and ad creative production

- Comfortable writing about AI, legal operations, business efficiency, or professional services

- Communicates proactively when something is off-track or needs a decision



Strongly Preferred:



- Background in B2B marketing, professional services, legal, or healthcare industries

- Experience supporting a founder or executive with personal brand and thought leadership content

- Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL), managing social scheduling, ad integrations, or marketing automations inside the platform

- Familiarity with AI writing tools (Claude, ChatGPT) for research and first-draft support



Bonus Points - You Move to the Top of the List:



GoHighLevel Certified: Social Media Manager Playbook

GoHighLevel Certified: Meta Ads Mastery

GoHighLevel Certified: Paid Ads Playbook



If you hold any or all of these GHL certifications, say so in your application and include your certificate. It will be noticed!!



What This Is Not



This is not a high-volume social media role posting to five platforms at once. The current focus is LinkedIn and Google Business Profile done well, done consistently, and done in a voice that makes PI law firm owners take us seriously. When paid ads launch, the same standard applies: precise targeting, clean creative, and results-driven management. A prospect who looks up Practivo AI online should find a company that looks like it knows exactly what it is doing.



Schedule and Working Arrangement



20 hours per week, flexible scheduling. A short weekly check-in call with the founder is required via WhatsApp some availability during U.S. Eastern Time (EST) business hours is needed for this call. All other hours are self-managed. Deliverables are deadline-based.



This is a long-term role. As Practivo scales into additional niches and paid advertising activates, this role grows with the company.



How to Apply



Please send:



- A writing sample: LinkedIn posts, B2B copy, or ad copy you've written (any industry)

- A screenshot or brief description of a LinkedIn profile or company page you've managed, including any results you can share

- Your experience with Meta Ads Manager: what types of campaigns you've run, what industries, and what results you achieved

- Any GoHighLevel certifications you hold include certificate screenshots or links

- A brief note on your Google Business Profile experience

- Your hours of availability and time zone



Applications without writing samples and Meta ads experience will not be reviewed.

description:

This role requires daily, hands-on work inside Shopify admin. If your Shopify experience is primarily supervisory, strategic, or developer-based, please do not apply. We will ask for a brief screen recording of you navigating Shopify admin as part of the screening process. If you've never personally built a landing page in Shogun or GemPages without a developer's help, or never configured ReCharge subscription settings or Rebuy widgets directly inside the app — this role is not for you.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a hands-on Shopify Store Manager to own the day-to-day operations of our online store. This is NOT a developer role and NOT a strategy-only role — you will live inside Shopify admin every single day, keeping everything running smoothly across product listings, apps, promotions, landing pages, and store content.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Upload and manage product listings — titles, descriptions, images, variants, pricing, and inventory

Build and update landing pages using page builder apps (Shogun, GemPages, or similar) for paid traffic, promos, and product launches

Create and manage discount codes, promotions, shipping settings, shipping zones, and payment gateway configuration

Configure and manage Shopify apps including Klaviyo, ReCharge, Okendo, Rebuy, and others

Set up and test cross-sell and upsell offers, subscription plans, and frequency options to increase AOV and LTV

Update collections, category pages, homepage content, and promotional banners

Coordinate with developers on technical projects — scope work, write clear requirements, and ensure delivery

Handle order fulfillment setup and printing configuration

Monitor store performance, flag issues proactively, and troubleshoot app/integration problems





REQUIREMENTS



3+ years as a hands-on Shopify store manager working inside Shopify admin daily — not a developer, not a strategist

Experience managing multiple Shopify stores simultaneously

Proficiency with Shogun, GemPages, or a similar page builder — you must be able to build mobile-optimized landing pages independently, without developer support

Hands-on experience configuring Klaviyo, ReCharge, Yotpo/Okendo, and Rebuy directly inside each app (not just awareness — actual configuration)

Ability to coordinate with developers and cross-functional teams; can write clear scopes and requirements

Strong attention to detail — product data accuracy, image quality, correct pricing, and consistent formatting

Proficiency with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to increase productivity

Excellent written and spoken English communication skills





NICE TO HAVE



Subscription e-commerce experience

Consumer goods background

Basic graphic design (Canva / Photoshop)

Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

Shopify theme editor experience





AVAILABILITY REQUIREMENT

You must have meaningful overlap with US Pacific Time business hours. Please indicate your available hours in your application.



HOW TO APPLY

We only review complete applications. Answer all four questions below — vague or generic answers will be disqualified. We are looking for specifics.

1. Independent vs. Agency

Are you an independent freelancer who will personally be doing this work, or do you represent an agency? Agency applicants will not be considered.

2. Rebuy / Cross-Sell & Upsell

Walk us through how you've set up and tested cross-sell or upsell offers in Rebuy — or a comparable app. Include: the specific widget type you used (e.g., Cart Upsell, Post-Purchase, PDP widget), where you placed it, what you tested, and what metric you used to evaluate performance. description:
**Title: Conversion Rate Optimization Specialist / Ecommerce CRO**



We are looking for a sharp, detail-oriented **Conversion Rate Optimization Specialist** to help improve the performance of our ecommerce funnels, landing pages, checkout flow, product pages, and offers.



This role is ideal for someone who understands ecommerce, direct response marketing, user behavior, analytics, and testing. You do not need to be a designer or developer, but you should be able to clearly identify what is hurting conversion and recommend practical improvements.



**Responsibilities:**



* Review ecommerce websites, landing pages, product pages, carts, and checkout flows

* Create CRO recommendations based on data, user behavior, and best practices

* Help plan A/B tests and track results

* Research competitors and high-performing ecommerce funnels

* Work with designers, developers, media buyers, and leadership to improve performance

* Create clear reports with findings, priorities, and next steps

* Suggest improvements to page structure, copy, offers, trust signals, pricing, bundles, upsells, and checkout flow



**Requirements:**



* Experience with ecommerce CRO, landing pages, Shopify, or direct response funnels

* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail

* Comfortable using tools like Google Analytics, Shopify analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Triple Whale, VWO, Optimizely, or similar tools

* Good understanding of buyer psychology, copywriting, UX, and funnel performance

* Able to explain recommendations clearly in writing

* Proactive and able to find problems without being micromanaged

* Reliable, organized, and consistent



**Nice to Have:**



* Experience with Shopify, CheckoutChamp, Triple Whale, Meta ads, Google ads, or
/SMS funnels

* Experience creating CRO audit reports

* Basic wireframing skills using Figma, Canva, Google Slides, or similar tools

* Experience with beauty, supplement, health, apparel, or consumer product brands



**What We Value:**



We want someone who thinks like an owner. Do not just complete tasks — look for problems, suggest improvements, and help us make better decisions. We value clear thinking, honest reporting, and practical execution.



**To Apply:**



Please send:



1. A short introduction about your CRO/ecommerce experience

2. Examples of CRO audits, landing pages, funnels, or tests you have worked on

3. Your experience with analytics or heatmap tools

4. Your expected hourly rate or monthly salary

6. Your MBTI type, if you know it



Please include the word **“CONVERSION”** in your application so we know you read the full post.

title: Supply Chain and Logistics Coordinator
description:
Position Summary

The Supply Chain & Logistics Coordinator is responsible for monitoring inbound shipments, coordinating with suppliers and freight partners, maintaining shipment visibility, ensuring timely document flow, and providing operational reports to support business continuity and inventory availability.



Key Responsibilities

1. Shipment Monitoring & Tracking

• Monitor all inbound shipments from supplier dispatch through final delivery. 

• Maintain and update shipment tracking reports. 

• Provide regular shipment status updates to management. 

• Identify and escalate shipment delays, missing documentation, and logistics issues. 

• Follow up with suppliers, freight forwarders, brokers, and warehouses regarding shipment progress. 

2. Logistics Coordination

• Coordinate shipment schedules with suppliers and logistics partners. 

• Track container movements and air shipments. 

• Assist in managing shipping timelines and expected arrival dates. 

• Ensure all parties are informed of shipment status changes. 

3. Documentation Management

• Collect, organize, and maintain shipment documentation, including: 

o Commercial Invoices 

o Packing Lists 

o Bills of Lading 

o Air Waybills 

o Customs documents 

• Verify completeness of shipping documents before clearance. 

• Coordinate document submission to brokers and relevant stakeholders. 

4. Operational Reporting

• Prepare shipment status reports and logistics summaries. 

• Maintain shipment trackers and operational dashboards. 

• Provide management with updates on pending, delayed, and completed shipments. 

• Assist in data gathering and reporting for business operations. 

5. Cross-Functional Coordination

• Liaise with suppliers, freight forwarders, brokers, warehouses, and internal teams. 

• Follow up on outstanding actions required for shipment movement and clearance. 

• Support resolution of logistics and documentation issues. 

6. Process Improvement

• Recommend improvements to shipment tracking and reporting processes. 

• Assist in maintaining accurate logistics records and operational procedures. 

• Support implementation of supply chain tracking tools and systems. 

7. Business Support Projects

• Conduct supplier and service provider research as requested.

title: Recruitment Operations & Client Success VA
description:
WISE SCOUT



RECRUITMENT OPERATIONS & CLIENT SUCCESS VA



Remote · Full-Time

ABOUT WISE SCOUT



Wise Scout is a recruitment firm that helps small and growing businesses find and hire exceptional remote talent, primarily in the Philippines. We're a small, tight-knit team that does meaningful work: we match the right people with the right opportunities and help businesses build teams they're genuinely proud of.

We're a caring, lighthearted team that believes work should be purposeful but not all-consuming. We care about our families, our people, and doing things well. If you've ever wanted to be part of a company where you're treated as a person first — this is that place.

We're growing, and this hire is a critical next step. The person who steps into this role won't just support the work, they'll help shape how we operate and eventually build a team of their own.



ROLE OVERVIEW



We're looking for a Recruitment Operations & Client Success VA to be the operational engine behind Wise Scout's hiring pipelines and client relationships. This is a role for someone who loves moving things forward; who sees a task and gets it done without waiting to be told twice.

You'll own the day-to-day execution of our recruitment process: setting up client meetings, building assessment pipelines, posting jobs, filtering candidates, tracking progress, and keeping clients informed every step of the way. You'll also support internal HR for our staff and jump into client-facing calls when needed.

This isn't a role where you'll wait for perfect instructions. We have processes — many of them — but they're still being refined. You'll need to be comfortable stepping into some ambiguity, figuring out what the next step is, and moving forward. If that excites you, you'll thrive here.



SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY



This role requires meaningful overlap with U.S. business hours, as client meetings and internal team calls happen in U.S. time zones.



- At least half of your working hours must be available during U.S. business hours in the Central time zone. During busy weeks, around a quarter of your hours will be spent in the U.S. Central time afternoons (between 12–4am PHT)

- Weekly all-hands meeting with the full Wise Scout team (Tuesdays 2pm CST/3am PHT)

- Weekly operational sync with Hiring Coordinator to drive hiring pipelines forward

- Schedule is otherwise flexible; we trust you to manage your time and deliver results





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



This role is broad but focused. Here are the five core areas you'll be responsible for:



1. CLIENT COMMUNICATION & RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT



- Set up and schedule intro calls with new clients; follow up with meeting notes, to-dos, and next steps

- Maintain consistent, professional communication with clients throughout the hiring process

- Send follow-up check-ins over days and weeks to stay top of mind with prospective clients

- Represent Wise Scout warmly and confidently in
 and on video calls

- Potentially run intro meetings and hiring calls with clients independently over time





2. HIRING PIPELINE MANAGEMENT



- Build and manage assessment pipelines in Criteria Corp for each active role

- Write experience questionnaires: self-assessment quizzes designed to quantify a candidate's background through how they answer, not just what they say

- Post job descriptions across multiple job boards

- Download and score applicants in spreadsheets; filter to top candidates based on scores and answers

- Move candidates through each stage of the pipeline with clear documentation and communication





3. RECRUITMENT REPORTING & TRACKING



- Maintain a master tracking spreadsheet showing all open roles, current stage, and time-in-process for each

- Upload data and report regularly to leadership on pipeline health: how many applicants, who's moving forward, and where things stand

- Ensure nothing falls through the cracks between steps or between client touchpoints





4. JOB DESCRIPTION WRITING



- Use AI tools (and interview notes) to draft compelling, accurate job descriptions for each client role

- Collaborate with team to refine and finalize before posting





5. INTERNAL HR & STAFF SUPPORT



- Check in regularly with Wise Scout's internal staff to gauge workload, morale, and needs

- Answer basic technical questions about Slack, 
, and other internal tools

- Track team hours in 
, compile timesheets, and submit payroll through 

- Support onboarding of new hires as the team grows





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Skills and tools can be taught. What we can't teach is the right wiring. Here's what that looks like for this role:



YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU:



- Are self-directed; you see what needs to happen next, and you do it

- Love checking things off a list and moving tasks forward without being prompted

- Are detail-oriented without being paralyzed by perfectionism — 90% shipped beats 100% stuck

- Communicate openly and confidently, both in writing and on video calls

- Are comfortable making mistakes and talking about them honestly, so the team can move on

- Solve problems independently; you Google it, look at how it was done before, and figure it out

- Enjoy understanding the whole process, not just your piece of it

- Can hold a lot of moving pieces simultaneously without dropping the ball



THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF YOU:



- Need clear, step-by-step instructions for everything before you can act

- Are uncomfortable with ambiguity or imperfect processes

- Avoid difficult conversations or are reluctant to give or receive direct feedback

- Struggle to communicate confidently with clients or leadership

- Get overwhelmed when managing multiple tasks or clients at once





TOOLS YOU'LL WORK WITH



You must arrive proficient in Google Workspace, especially Google Sheets and Gmail. Everything else can be learned on the job.



- Google Workspace: Gmail, Google Sheets, Google Docs, Google Meet (must-have on day one)

- Slack: internal team communication

- Criteria Corp: assessment and hiring pipeline tool (we'll train you)

- 
: time tracking for internal staff

- QuickBooks Online: bookkeeping and invoicing (light exposure helpful)

- 
: payroll and payments

- AI writing tools: to assist with job descriptions,
s, and candidate summaries

- Fathom or similar AI note takers: for meeting documentation





WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT INCLUDE



To be clear about scope:



- No marketing, social media, or content creation

- No image design or creative work

- No bookkeeping or accounting responsibility





TRAINING & ONBOARDING



This position includes a three-month training and onboarding period. We don't expect perfection on day one — we invest in getting you up to speed the right way. Here's roughly what the arc looks like:



- Week 1: Learn our tools, processes, and active client roster; shadow existing pipelines; get familiar with our communication style and documentation

- Month 1: Take ownership of client communication for existing roles; begin building and managing assessment pipelines with guidance

- Month 2: Run pipeline reporting independently; begin drafting job descriptions and experience questionnaires with light review

- Month 3: Fully own your client relationships and hiring pipelines; begin joining or running client calls; formal performance review at 90 days



We meet regularly throughout; you won't be left guessing. And if something isn't working, we'll talk about it directly and fix it together.



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



We believe in being transparent about what you can earn — not just today, but down the road. Here's the full picture:

This position includes a three-month training and onboarding period, compensated at $5.50/hour. After this period, compensation increases to $6.00–$7.00/hour for the following nine months. After your first full year, compensation increases to $7.50–$9.00/hour based on performance, with annual raises to follow.

Over the next 3–5 years, this individual would progress into a strategically focused leadership role, managing a team of their own, at compensation ranging from $30,000–$40,000 USD annually ($1.7M–$2.25M Philippine pesos).



ADDITIONAL DETAILS:



- Twice-monthly payroll: hours worked 1st–15th paid on the 20th; 16th–end of month paid on the 5th

- Monthly PhilHealth and SSS contribution reimbursement (minimum $30/month), beginning after your training period

- Annual performance-based raises

- Performance bonuses or profit sharing eligibility beginning at 9 months

- 15 days PTO per year (years 1–2)  -> 18 days (years 2–5)  -> 21 days (5+ years)

- 6–8 paid holidays (U.S. holidays observed; flexibility for key Philippine holidays)





GROWTH & LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



This is not a dead-end role — it's a launchpad.

As Wise Scout grows, so does this position. The person who excels here will have the opportunity to move into a team leadership role, eventually managing a small team of their own that supports the full client roster. That means more responsibility, more compensation, and a real career path — not just a job.

We're not looking for someone to plug a gap. We're looking for someone to grow with us for the long haul. If you're still here in three years, we want you to look back and say this was one of the best decisions you ever made.



TO APPLY, please click the following link: 
/o/JB-7CRXVT8PL/landing?u=
Here, you will be prompted to upload a resume, fill out an Experience Questionnaire, and take a quick assessment. If you pass this first round, we will send you a few follow-up assessments.

The last round will involve sending in a video recording of yourself answering a handful of questions, then a live face-to-face interview. Then we will make our final decision.

PLEASE NOTE: It is best to have already taken your English Proficiency Assessment on your Onlinejobs.ph profile through 
 and the IQ Test through 
 before applying, as we will request both in the application process. It is not mandatory to have them completed, but it will improve your chances of moving along in the process.



— The Wise Scout Team

title: Bid Coordinator / Executive Assistant — Commercial Roofing (Construction Experience Preferred)

We run business development and pre-construction for commercial roofing contractors in Denver, CO and Phoenix, AZ. We are a small, fast, systems-driven team: the owner (me), an estimator (Philippines-based), and you.

You are the bridge between our finished estimates and the general contractors who receive them. Once our estimator finishes a bid, you take over: you submit it by
, you follow up relentlessly, you schedule calls for the owner, and you build the owner's daily schedule. You will follow written SOPs for everything — and help improve them.



Daily Responsibilities





Bid submission — Take completed bid PDFs and submit them to general contractors by
 using our templates.

Follow-up management — Run our follow-up cadence (minimum weekly per open bid, up to daily when a decision is close) until we get a yes, a no, or pricing feedback. We never let a bid die from silence.

Call scheduling — Get GC estimators and project managers on the phone with the owner. You propose times, confirm, and put them on his calendar.

Inbox triage & escalation — When a GC replies with questions: route technical questions to our estimator first; anything he can't answer goes on the owner's schedule for the next day.

Daily schedule assembly — Every evening, build the owner's next-day schedule: calls booked, follow-ups needing his voice, supplier negotiations, and how many new projects the estimator needs sourced per client.

Pipeline hygiene — Update deal stages and log all GC feedback in our CRM/portal.





Requirements





Excellent written English (you will
 American general contractors daily — your
s must read like a native US professional wrote them)

Confident, professional phone/email manner — you will be politely persistent with busy people

Extremely organized; you live by checklists and follow SOPs exactly, and you flag when an SOP is broken

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, own computer

Available during US Mountain Time morning hours





Big Plus (mention in your application)





Construction industry experience (estimating, PM coordination, bid submission, procurement)

Familiarity with roofing or commercial construction terms (RFQ, takeoff, scope, submittals, GC)

Experience with Slack, Google Workspace, CRMs, and calendar management

Experience as an EA managing a founder's schedule

Reply with:





The word "BLUEPRINT" in the first line (so I know you read this)

2–3 sentences on your construction/estimating exposure (or the closest thing to it)

A short paragraph, written as if you were
ing a GC estimator to follow up on a bid we submitted 6 days ago with no response. This is the most important part of your application.

Your expected monthly salary and available hours in Mountain Time

title: Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Purpose 

The Offshore Short-Form Video Editor turns raw footage from Paul Peterson and Alarmed Media LLC into high-retention, platform-ready short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts,
 Reels, LinkedIn, and other assigned channels. This role requires technical editing skill, strong pacing, clean captions, emotional judgment, and the ability to make educational mental health content feel engaging, credible, and shareable without becoming gimmicky or misleading.



Key Performance Indicators and Reporting 

- Complete 12–18 finished short-form videos per week during the initial phase, scaling toward 15–25 videos per week as assigned based on complexity and support. 

- Deliver first drafts within 24–48 hours after receiving usable raw footage and clear instructions. 

- Complete final revisions within 24 hours when feedback is clear and all source assets are available. 

- Maintain 90%+ approval within two revision rounds by following brand standards and instructions accurately. 

- Maintain at least 98?curacy for captions, spelling, grammar, platform formatting, export settings, and file names. 

- Produce correct platform versions, including 9:16 vertical exports and any assigned 1:1, 4:5, 16:9, thumbnail, or caption file formats. 

- Identify editing patterns, hooks, first-frame choices, caption styles, or pacing choices that may improve retention and report them weekly. 

- Use only approved, licensed, royalty-free, owned, or properly authorized music, images, video clips, graphics, fonts, templates, and AI-generated assets. 

- Maintain zero unauthorized use of client footage, PHI, testimonial material, OAC-restricted assets, copyrighted content, or unapproved third-party materials. 

- Organize raw files, project files, final exports, caption files, and archive folders according to approved naming and storage standards. 

- Upon achieving these key performance indicators, the supervisor will meet with the contractor to review progress and collaborate on establishing new performance goals that reflect continued growth, quality, and accountability. 



Core Competencies 

- Demonstrate strong short-form video editing skill, including pacing, captions, cuts, pattern interrupts, sound, first-frame quality, and retention editing. 

- Demonstrate the ability to preserve Paul’s message while improving clarity, energy, and watchability. 

- Demonstrate good taste and restraint with mental health content so edits feel credible, emotional, and professional rather than flashy or disrespectful. 

- Demonstrate strong file organization, version control, attention to detail, and ability to meet recurring deadlines. 

- Demonstrate appropriate escalation when footage, content, claims, privacy, or source materials create risk. 



Core Responsibilities 

– These duties may vary depending on project assignments and Company needs. 

- Edit raw footage into short-form videos, typically between 10 and 75 seconds unless otherwise assigned. 

- Create platform-ready versions for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts,
 Reels, LinkedIn, and other assigned channels. 

- Add accurate burned-in captions, clean text overlays, strong first frames, and visual emphasis that supports the message. 

- Remove dead space, unnecessary pauses, filler, repeated words, weak openings, and confusing sections while preserving accuracy. 

- Use zooms, cuts, b-roll, graphics, music, and pattern interrupts only when they strengthen the message and match the brand. 

- Repurpose long-form videos, interviews, podcasts, or presentations into short clips when assigned. 

- Recommend stronger openings, clip selections, titles, or visual structures when raw footage contains a better hook later in the recording. 

- Export and label all final files clearly by date, topic, platform, version, and approval status. 

- Maintain editing templates, caption presets, brand elements, file structures, and project files for reuse. 

- Communicate quickly when raw footage, audio, lighting, file access, instructions, or source materials are incomplete or unusable. 

- Perform other duties as assigned commensurate with the position duties. 

- Adhere to all Alarmed Media LLC policies, confidentiality rules, contractor agreements, and platform-access standards. 



Required Qualifications 

- 2+ years of short-form video editing experience preferred, especially with TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts,
 Reels, or personal-brand content. 

- Experience editing educational, podcast, founder-led, coaching, health, mental health, or mission-driven content preferred. 

- Proficiency with CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or comparable editing software required. 

- Strong English captioning, spelling, grammar, and on-screen text judgment required. 

- Ability to export clean vertical 9:16 video and adapt videos for multiple platform requirements. 

- Reliable computer, internet access, and secure file-management practices required.

title: Content Producer/Project Manager
description:

The Offshore Content Producer / Project Manager runs the operating system that turns Paul Peterson’s ideas, clinical insights, stories, and brand message into a disciplined media production workflow. This role owns the content calendar, filming packets, project tracker, production deadlines, approval workflow, reporting rhythm, and coordination between editing, posting, analytics, and content planning. The role is designed to keep Paul focused on filming, message direction, approval, and high-level strategy while the offshore team executes the daily production machine. 



Key Performance Indicators and Reporting 

- Maintain a rolling 14-day content calendar at least 95% of the time, with topics, hooks, platforms, owners, status, and due dates clearly documented. 

- Prepare filming packets at least 24 hours before scheduled filming sessions at least 95% of the time.

- Escalate 100% of clinical, legal, privacy, client-story, testimonial, OAC-related, crisis, or high-risk content before publication or distribution. 

- Identify at least 3 winning content patterns, hooks, formats, or audience themes per month and recommend how to repeat or expand them. 

- Complete at least one substantive workflow, template, tracker, reporting, or production-process improvement quarterly. 

- Upon achieving these key performance indicators, the supervisor will meet with the contractor to review progress and collaborate on establishing new performance goals that reflect continued growth, quality, and accountability.



Core Competencies 

- Demonstrate strong content operations, project management, deadline management, and remote-team coordination skill. 

- Demonstrate the ability to translate Paul’s spoken ideas into clear hooks, filming prompts, content series, and platform-ready production plans. 

- Demonstrate sound judgment around sensitive mental health content, clinical boundaries, privacy, and brand risk. 

- Demonstrate strong organization, data accuracy, documentation discipline, and follow-through across daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly deadlines. 

- Demonstrate the ability to identify trends, bottlenecks, content performance patterns, and recommended next actions from reporting. 



Core Responsibilities 

– These duties may vary depending on project assignments and Company needs. 

- Build and maintain the weekly and monthly content calendar for Alarmed Media LLC. 

- Prepare filming packets for Paul Peterson, including hooks, prompts, talking points, intended platform, target length, audience, and emotional objective.

- Perform other duties as assigned commensurate with the position duties. 

- Adhere to all Alarmed Media LLC policies, confidentiality rules, contractor agreements, and platform-access standards. 



Required Qualifications 

- 2+ years of experience in content production, project management, social media operations, digital media, marketing coordination, podcast/video production, or comparable work preferred. 

- Experience supporting a founder, executive, clinician, educator, coach, personal brand, or high-volume content creator preferred. 

- Experience coordinating remote/offshore teams, creative workflows, project trackers, and recurring production deadlines preferred. 

- Strong written English and ability to draft hooks, prompts, captions, task instructions, and weekly reports.

Your main result: book qualified appointments with homeowners who are genuinely open to reviewing solar options to lower the electric bill for their home.



REQUIREMENTS

- Strong, clear, easy-to-understand spoken English

- Comfortable making 100+ phone calls per day and being on the phone most of your shift

- Stable internet, quiet workspace, good headset

- Able to work US Eastern hours (night shift PH time)

- Previous appointment setting / cold calling / call center experience is a PLUS but NOT REQUIRED as long as you sound great and have a positive attitude.

- No solar experience needed – we will train you on the product and process.



SCHEDULE

- Monday to Friday, US Eastern hours (night shift in PH, roughly 9:00pm–5:00am PH time)



COMPENSATION (USD EQUIVALENT)

- Your actual hourly rate will be agreed in PHP within this range and paid weekly via Wise/PayPal.

- After consistent good performance for 2 straight months, your hourly rate will be reviewed for a raise (towards the $4.00+ range).

- Strong performers can grow to the equivalent of $4.50–$5.25+ per hour over time.



This is an hourly role with performance-based raises, not a commission-only job. You get paid during training. You must have your own computer, headset, and reliable internet connection.
