title: Music Catalog Producer & Audio Assets Manager
description:
Ventured Entertainment is seeking an organized, efficient Music Catalog Producer & Audio Assets Manager to spearhead the expansion of our master instrumental library. This is a highly specialized technical production role. You will not be making tracks from scratch; instead, you will function as our digital audio architect—sourcing, downloading, arranging, and meticulously archiving premium music construction kits into a massive, commercially ready instrumental catalog.



The ideal candidate has a strong background in music production, a deep understanding of song structure across multiple genres, and an obsession with file organization. You must have a fast internet connection, heavy file-download capabilities, and mastery of a modern Digital Audio Workstation (DAW).



Scope of Responsibilities

Asset Acquisition & Downloading: Utilize company-provided access to Rapidgator and specialized audio curation sites to efficiently download targeted music construction kits.



Audio Arrangement & Stitching: Analyze the downloaded construction kits. If a full-length instrumental is not already included, you will import the individual stems/loops into your DAW (Logic, FL Studio, Pro Tools, etc.) and professionally arrange, mix, and sequence them into a complete, cohesive 2-to-3-minute instrumental track.



Catalog Curation & Genre Sorting: Accurately classify every completed track by its exact genre (e.g., Hip-Hop, R&B, Grunge, Pop) and ensure it meets our quality standards.



Meticulous Google Drive Management: Maintain a highly organized, standardized cloud storage system. You will upload, name, and archive the full wave file instrumentals into their designated genre folders within our master Google Drive catalog.



Requirements & Technical Qualifications

DAW Mastery: High proficiency in at least one professional Digital Audio Workstation (e.g., Logic Pro, FL Studio, Ableton Live, Pro Tools, Cubase).



Music Production & Arrangement Skills: A sharp ear for tempo, key, and arrangement. You must know how to take fragmented loops/stems and smoothly arrange them so they sound like a naturally flowing, radio-ready instrumental.



Data & File Management Capabilities: You must have the hardware capacity and a high-speed internet connection capable of handling heavy daily download volumes from Rapidgator and large uploads to Google Drive.



Extreme Attention to Detail: Obsessive about file naming conventions, folder structures, and digital organization.

Self-Discipline & Speed: Ability to work independently, manage your own production workflow, and consistently hit catalog volume targets without sacrificing audio quality.

title: Executive Assistant

The right person is polished, resourceful, highly communicative, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly. mbers, contractors, partners, and vendors.

Personal Assistant Support

- Assist with personal scheduling, appointments, reservations, and coordination.

- Research and book travel, hotels, transportation, restaurants, events, and experiences.

- Help coordinate personal errands, gifting, shopping, household-related tasks, and special requests.

- Manage high-touch details for trips, events, personal plans, and lifestyle needs.

- Communicate with vendors, service providers, hospitality teams, and luxury brands when needed.

- Support the CEOs in creating a more organized, efficient, and seamless personal schedule.



High-Level Organization & Operations

- Build and maintain clear systems for tasks, documents, schedules, travel plans, and recurring responsibilities.

- Keep track of priorities across multiple areas of the business and personal life.

- Anticipate upcoming needs and proactively prepare solutions.

- Create structure around recurring tasks and improve current processes.

- Ensure communication is clear, polished, timely, and professional.

- Help protect the CEOs’ time by filtering priorities and keeping things organized.



Requirements

- Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, Personal Assistant, Chief of Staff Assistant, or similar role.

- Experience supporting CEOs, founders, entrepreneurs, executives, or high-profile individuals preferred.

- Experience working with luxury brands, premium service businesses, high-end hospitality, personal styling, travel, events, real estate, or other elevated client experiences is a strong plus.

- Extremely organized with strong attention to detail.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to handle both business and personal tasks professionally.

- Strong discretion and confidentiality.

- Ability to work independently and take initiative without constant direction.

- Comfortable managing multiple priorities at once.

- Resourceful, solutions-oriented, and calm under pressure.

- Strong follow-through and ability to complete tasks quickly and accurately.

- Comfortable using tools such as Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Calendly, Zoom, or similar platforms.

You are the kind of person who notices the small details, remembers preferences, follows up before being reminded, and knows how to make things feel seamless. You understand the importance of discretion, clear communication, and representing the executives and company well in every interaction.

You should be equally comfortable organizing a business calendar, coordinating travel, following up with a tea
mber, booking a luxury hotel, managing a personal appointment, or creating a simple system to make recurring tasks easier.

The ideal candidate is reliable, communicative, and able to manage tasks quickly while maintaining accuracy and professionalism.

, and CRM

Hit and exceed monthly sales targets

Hard Requirements — Non-Negotiable

Fluent English — Written and spoken English must be at a near-native or native level. You will be speaking with homeowners and business owners in California daily. Accent is not a barrier, but clarity, grammar, and confidence are required.



Proven sales experience — You must have a demonstrated track record of closing deals, managing pipelines, and hitting targets. Experience in home services, solar, HVAC, roofing, energy, or a related industry is strongly preferred.



Self-motivated and accountable — You will be working remotely with minimal supervision. We need someone who manages their own time, follows up without being asked, and takes ownership of their pipeline.

Candidates with no prior sales or customer-facing experience

Compensation

Performance bonuses for hitting monthly targets

Long-term opportunity to grow with the company as we scale toward $100k+/month in revenue

How to Apply

Submit your application with the following:



Your updated resume or CV

A brief cover letter (3–5 sentences) explaining why you are the right fit for this role

title: Direct Response VSL Editor: ($1,800 to $2,200/mo + Bonus)
description:
The offer, up front



$1,800 to $2,200 per month retainer depending on what you show us, plus a performance bonus when your ads win. We pay for every AI tool you need: Higgsfield, Veo, Seedance, Grok, Nano Banana, and whatever launches next month.



***We want an editor who works with us and ONLY US full time all the time. If you have another job and are trying to manage both please do not apply you won't fit in here and will probably be fired with no pay.



Why we are different



FL sells a supplement for connective tissue health. Our customers are women between 40 and 65 with fibromyalgia or chronic pain or stiffness. Meta is our main acquisition channel and we spend 10,000USD on it every single day.



So your cut goes live within days of export. By Friday you will know its hook rate, its hold rate, and its CPA. 



That data cuts both ways. If your hooks do not hold, you will see it. If they do, you get paid for it.



What you do here:





Cut VSLs and short-form direct response ads from scripts we hand you

Generate your own footage with AI video tools: talking-head UGC, b-roll, product visuals. If you cannot generate assets, you cannot do this job.

Ship 4-7 minutes of edit daily. We test volume. We do not polish one masterpiece for a month.

Cut a hook, then cut ten more versions of it. The first three seconds d
 whether the other ninety exist.

Own captions, sound design, music, on-screen text, pacing, and exports at 9:16, 4:5, and 1:1





What we need





2+ years cutting direct response video.

Hands-on AI video generation. Name the tools, name what you made with them, link it.

Premiere Pro, CapCut, or DaVinci Resolve. CapCut Pro fluency is a plus. Most of our short-form lives there.

You speak the language. Hook rate, hold rate, thumbstop. Tell us your best numbers and how you got them.



Speed. A brief on Monday means a cut same day.

Written English strong enough to read a 4,000-word advertorial and pull the three lines worth putting on screen.

You answer whatsapp within a few hours during your working hours. You do not go quiet for two days.





Bonus points:





You have cut supplement, health, or beauty DTC ads

You have worked on advertorial or long-form VSL

You have arguments about what makes an ad work, and you will make them to us





Compensation:





$1,800 to $2,200 per month retainer, based on your reel and your test cut

Performance bonus on winning ads. Top editors add $1000 to $2000 per month.

Every AI tool subscription covered

Paid by Wise, Deel, or your preferred method





What this is not



No approval chain. No creative committee. You send a cut, we launch it, we tell you what happened.



We are hiring more editors this year. When we need a creative lead, we would rather promote you - there is huge growth potential here.



How to apply



Send all four:



1. Three to five of your best direct response cuts. VSL, UGC, or short-form. Where you know the numbers, tell us the numbers.



2. At least one clip you generated with an AI video tool. Name the tool. Tell us the prompt.



3. A Loom under three minutes: who you are, one ad you are proud of and why it worked, and why you want this role.

title: Loan Officer Assistant
description:
Who We Are:

Dominion Financial Services (DFS) is a nationally recognized private lender dedicated to supporting real estate investors. With a focus on Short-Term Bridge Loans and Long-Term Rental Loans, DFS empowers clients to scale their businesses and build lasting generational wealth. DFS stands out as a leader, consistently achieving strong, measurable growth quarter after quarter. We are currently seeking a detail-oriented and driven Loan Officer Assistant to join our rapidly expanding team and contribute to our mission of empowering real estate investors across the nation.



At Dominion, we are committed to building a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. We embrace emerging technologies, including AI, to help our tea
mbers work more efficiently, solve problems more effectively, and create greater impact in their roles. Employees are encouraged to explore new tools and processes that improve productivity, enhance the customer experience, and support the company's growth.



Our Company’s Core Values

- Integrity

- Accountable & Dependable

- Team Centric

- System & Process Oriented

- Service Ethic

- Organized Efficiency - Risk Management & Compliance



Your Impact:

- Ensure a seamless transition from loan quote to intake, maintaining accuracy and efficiency.

- Support loan officers by managing intake workflows and ensuring timely follow-ups.

- Improve process efficiency by keeping data and documentation well-organized and up to date.



In This Role You Will:

- Manage loan transitions from quote status to intake, ensuring priority and accuracy.

- Monitor the loan intake queue and initiate file setup based on submission dates.

- Review loan documentation for completeness and accuracy.

- Set up digital folders and enter key borrower and entity information into the loan origination system.

- Order and upload third-party reports from external platforms.

- Send and follow up on initial document requests to key contacts.

- Coordinate internally with appraisal specialists, processors, and the operations team to ensure timely file progression.

- Maintain accurate communication notes within internal systems.

- Utilize internal checklists to verify all required documents are collected and properly categorized.

- Perform preliminary quality control on documents and escalate issues when necessary.

- Monitor loan files using status dashboards and checklists to track progress.

- Transition files to the next stage once all intake requirements are complete.

- Ensure data and documentation in both the CRM and LOS remain up to date.

- Follow up daily for missing documents and escalate delays as needed.

- Document all follow-ups and status changes in internal systems.



Requirements:

- 1–3 years of experience in mortgage, lending, financial services, or operations support.

- Strong working knowledge of loan documentation, loan file structures, and intake workflows.

- Proficiency with CRM systems (Salesforce) and loan origination systems (experience with LendingWise is a plus).

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel and Outlook.

- Demonstrated ability to follow structured processes and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

- Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.



Preferred Qualifications:

- Familiarity with third-party mortgage tools and vendor platforms (e.g., Xactus, TLOxp, DataTree).

- Experience organizing and reviewing legal entity documentation (LLCs, Trusts, Corporations).

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Real Estate, or related field.



AI-Enabled Workplace

Our company actively incorporates artificial intelligence into daily operations and expects tea
mbers to utilize AI tools as part of their standard workflow. All employees are provided with access to Claude, including unlimited token usage, and are encouraged to leverage AI to increase productivity, automate routine tasks, improve communication, enhance decision-making, and drive innovation. Experience with AI tools is preferred, and a willingness to adopt AI-assisted work practices is expected for this role.



Project Details:

- $20/hour

- Full-time (40 hours per week)

- Long-term, stable engagement

- Fully remote

- U.S. Eastern Time working hours

- Access to Claude AI with unlimited usage

- Work directly with company leadership

- Opportunity for advancement as the company grows

title: AI YouTube Video Producer (Storytelling & History)
description:
About Us

We are a fast-growing YouTube company producing high-quality long-form videos in the history and storytelling niche. Our videos combine cinematic narration with AI-generated visuals to create immersive experiences that keep viewers watching.

We are looking for someone who loves history, storytelling, and AI tools, and wants to grow with us long-term.



What You'll Be Doing

This is NOT a traditional video editing job.

Your main responsibility is to bring our narration to life by creating cinematic AI visuals that perfectly match the story.

Your job is to:

Read the script carefully

Understand the story

Generate realistic cinematic shots using Higgsfield/heygen voice generation

Choose camera movements, angles, lighting, and compositions that fit the narration

Edit everything into a polished YouTube video

Add subtle sound design, music, and transitions where appropriate

Maintain excellent pacing throughout the video

Typical video length:

20–180  minutes



We're Looking For Someone Who...

Has a strong sense of storytelling

Understands cinematic composition

Has experience editing long-form YouTube videos

Can think creatively instead of simply following instructions

Pays close attention to detail

Has excellent English comprehension

Delivers projects on time

Is willing to learn new AI tools



Bonus Skills

Experience with any of these is a huge plus:

Higgsfield

Midjourney

Nano Banana

Kling

Runway

Veo

Adobe Premiere Pro

DaVinci Resolve

Photoshop

If you already create AI-generated cinematic videos, we definitely want to hear from you.



What We Offer

Long-term remote position

Consistent weekly work

Access to premium AI tools

Opportunity to work on multiple YouTube channels

Flexible working hours



How To Apply





Your portfolio (YouTube videos only)

Tell us which AI tools you have experience with.

What is your favorite historical period, and why?

Describe your workflow for turning a voice-over into a finished YouTube video.

If you've used Higgsfield before, include links to your best work.

Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered

title: Youtube Post-Production Manager
description:
This Is a YouTube-First Role



This is not a traditional post-production manager role. We are specifically looking for someone with deep experience in YouTube-native content, where success is driven by pacing, retention, iteration speed, and audience engagement, not traditional film, TV, or broadcast workflows.



If your background is primarily in film, television, or commercial post-production with long timelines or on-set focused processes, this role will not be a good fit.



If you’ve worked closely with creators, managed YouTube editors, shipped content weekly, and think about edits through a performance and viewer-retention lens, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.



Who We Are:



Five years ago, Dragonfruit set out to bring together some of the most talented visual storytellers, viral video strategists, and big-name clients, to change the way we create and consume on YouTube.The result has been bigger than we could have imagined, having generated billions of organic views and hundreds of millions of subscribers for creators like MrBeast, Ali Abdaal, Chris Williamson, Codie Sanchez, Neil Patel and orgs like Y Combinator, e.l.f beauty, WHOOP, ClickUp, Linktree, Center for Humane Technology & more.





Unlike other social media agencies or YouTube businesses, Dragonfruit refuses to celebrate a “creator economy” that trades viewers’ time and attention for rapid-fire dopamine entertainment.





Instead, we are leading a global movement to make YouTube a more valuable and educational place for all people; where views and subscribers are never an end in and of themselves, but rather a means of increasing human flourishing; where viral-educational YouTube channels not only bolster awareness and impact for our client's brands, but also create genuine value in viewers’ lives.





The Role:



As a Post-Production Manager at Dragonfruit, you’ll sit at the operational center of some of the most influential YouTube channels in the world — ensuring that hundreds of videos each month move smoothly from edit to delivery without sacrificing quality, speed, or storytelling impact.



You’ll oversee the end-to-end post-production process across multiple client accounts, coordinating with editors, creative directors, and producers to make sure timelines are met, files are organized, and every piece of content leaving the studio reflects Dragonfruit’s standards of excellence. You’re not just tracking edits — you’re architecting the systems that make world-class content possible at scale.





You’ll identify workflow inefficiencies, establish clear SOPs, enforce QC standards, and act as the connective tissue between creative and operations. Success in this role means becoming the person everyone relies on to keep post-production running at peak performance — calm under pressure, obsessed with detail, and relentless about shipping great work on time.





Skills and Qualifications:



3+ years of experience specifically in YouTube content production within an agency, production company, or YouTube-focused environment

Proven experience editing high-performing YouTube long forms

Proven experience reviewing and improving other editors’ work — with the ability to give clear, actionable, and constructive feedback

Proven ability to manage large-scale, multi-client pipelines, overseeing 300+ assets in various stages of post-production simultaneously.

Deep understanding of the creative workflow — from ingest and assembly through QC, revision management, and final delivery.

Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (especially Premiere Pro and After Effects) and familiarity with collaborative tools like 
, ClickUp, Notion, or similar project-management platforms.

Strong organizational and systems-thinking mindset — able to spot process bottlenecks and implement scalable solutions.

Exceptional attention to detail and ability to maintain high quality standards under tight deadlines.

Experience leading and mentoring editors teams, setting clear expectations, and managing bandwidth.

Expert communicator and problem solver with strong interpersonal skills

Bonus: familiarity with YouTube analytics, retention data, and how editing choices affect performance.





What you can expect:



An exciting creative startup culture – operate cross-functionally, wear several hats, and occasionally work long hours, during evenings, and/or weekends. We are a hungry and ambitious group of people trying to accomplish something large and challenging and we’re looking for folks who are enthusiastic and willing to do what is required to reach their goals.

Personal growth – use Dragonfruit’s culture of excellence as an incubator to improve your professional skills, learn new mental models, sharpen your critical thinking, and operate at the forefront of new media.

Be a key player in a fast-growing company – help take the company from 40 employees to 100+, identifying blind spots in our service offering and working collaboratively with leadership to improve systems/processes.

Earn more – take advantage of regular performance-based raises, generous referral and sales commissions, & more.





Perks:



Work from anywhere (we're 100% remote)

Competitive Healthcare Coverage (medical, dental, vision)

Gifts/cash bonuses on birthdays, work anniversaries, and other work-related achievements

Unlimited reimbursements on book purchases (we like to read )

Paid volunteering: 1 day dedicated to supporting a cause of your choice

Work directly with some of the largest creators/brands on the planet

Work for a company that is values-oriented and committed to positive social impact



If you're ready to join Dragonfruit and play a role in the future of YouTube, apply now!

title: Instagram outreach assistant
description:
:



INSTAGRAM OUTREACH ASSISTANT



Your job is to use my Instagram account to identify and message women who fit a specific profile before shows, events, trips, dinners, villa weekends, and content shoots.



I will provide examples of the exact type of profiles I am looking for. Your job is to learn the pattern and execute it consistently.



PROCESS



Step 1: Research the city.



Find the highest-end venues in the city, including:



* Beach clubs

* Rooftop venues

* Luxury hotels

* High-end restaurants

* Members clubs

* Fashion and lifestyle venues

* Popular nightlife venues



Step 2: Use Instagram location tags.



Search the venue’s Instagram location.



Review people who have recently posted from that location.



Do not focus on the venue’s tagged photos.



Focus on people posting from the location itself.



Step 3: Identify qualified profiles.



Look for women who match the examples provided. 



General guidelines:



* Attractive

* Stylish

* Fashionable

* Luxury, travel, beach club, and nightlife aesthetic

* High-quality photos

* Active Instagram account

* Minimal visible tattoos preferred



Follower Count



Preferred:

0–100,000 followers



However, if the profile is an excellent fit, larger accounts are acceptable.



Profile quality is more important than follower count.



Step 4: Outreach



Send approved outreach messages from my account.



Handle basic responses according to my instructions.



Flag promising conversations for my review.



Step 5: Find Additional Prospects



Once a woman responds positively, review the women she follows on Instagram.



Many of the best prospects will come from the accounts followed by women who have already responded positively.



When you find women who fit the profile, send outreach messages to them as well.



After a positive response:



1. Open her Instagram profile.

2. Review who she follows.

3. Identify women who fit the profile.

4. Send outreach messages to those women.

5. Repeat the process as new positive responses come in.



Cities



Cities will change depending on upcoming shows and trips.



Success Metrics



* Number of outreach messages sent

* Number of responses received

* Number of positive conversations

* Number of qualified women identified

* Number of attendees confirmed for events



Translate to Portuguese. But they need speak English too

We’re hiring a part-time Brand Identity & Web Designer for approximately 25-30 hours per week, with a clear path to full-time as our client roster grows.



This is a brand identity and website design role. We need someone who is genuinely strong in two core areas:



Logo design and brand identity systems

Figma-based website design that is structured, responsive, and buildable



This is not primarily a social media graphics role. Social graphics and collateral may come up occasionally, but the heart of this seat is brand systems and websites.



Primary Work



Most of your work will include:



Logo design and brand identity systems

Creating logo concepts, refining marks, building brand packages, developing logo variations, color palettes, typography systems, and usage guidelines.

Website and UI design in Figma

Designing complete website experiences including homepages, landing pages, interior page systems, responsive layouts, interactive states, and clean handoff files for developers.

Brand refresh projects

Taking an existing client brand and modernizing the full identity system, then carrying that refreshed visual direction into their website and digital presence.

Design systems and consistency

Building layouts, components, and visual systems that feel polished, intentional, and easy for our development team to understand.



Your designs need to be more than pretty screens. They need to have hierarchy, structure, purpose, and enough order that our developers don’t have to decode them like ancient ruins.



Secondary Work



Occasionally, you may also help with:



Social media graphics and templates

Proposal covers

Slide decks

One-pagers

Simple marketing collateral

Canva template systems that clients can maintain themselves



Again, these are secondary. If your strongest work is social graphics or Canva templates, you may be better suited for a future production design role. For this seat, we’re hiring for brand identity systems and websites first.



Tools We Use



You should be comfortable with:



Figma — required

All website and UI design happens here. You should be fluent with components, auto-layout, responsive layout thinking, and prototyping.

Adobe Illustrator — required

Logo and identity work happens here. Photoshop may be used as needed.

Canva — helpful

Used occasionally for client-friendly template systems.

ClickUp — we’ll train you

This is where we manage projects, tasks, and deadlines.



Reliable internet and your own computer are required. Adobe Illustrator access is required. Creative Nomads will provide access to team-based tools where applicable, including project management and shared Figma workflows.



Who We’re Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you have:



3+ years of professional design experience across both brand identity and web design

A portfolio with at least 3 logo/brand identity projects

A portfolio with at least 3 complete website designs you created yourself

Strong typography instincts — you know why a wordmark works, not just that it looks nice

A clear understanding of UX fundamentals: hierarchy, user flow, responsive behavior, and designing for conversion

The ability to design within an existing brand system, not only create from scratch

Experience preparing Figma files that developers can actually build from

Comfort receiving and applying feedback through revision rounds

Excellent written English for daily communication with our U.S.-based team

Reliable internet and a dependable work setup

A self-managed, deadline-driven working style



We work asynchronously and trust our team. That means you’ll have freedom, but also responsibility. A beautiful thing, unless you hate calendars.



Bonus Points



These are not required, but they are helpful:



Experience designing for nonprofits, churches, ministries, authors, speakers, or mission-driven brands

Understanding of how websites get built in WordPress or modern web frameworks

Experience designing landing pages for conversion

Motion graphics, micro-interactions, or simple animation skills

Experience using AI design tools well — as accelerators, not replacements for craft

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days



In your first month, you’ll learn our design process, client types, brand standards, and handoff expectations.



By 60–90 days, you should be able to take clear creative direction and turn it into polished logo concepts, brand identity systems, and structured Figma website designs that our development team can build without needing a treasure map.



You’ll be successful if you can:



Understand the strategy behind a brand or website before designing

Create polished visual concepts with clear rationale

Organize Figma files cleanly

Apply feedback without losing 
ntum

Communicate clearly when something is unclear

Meet deadlines consistently

Help us raise the quality of our brand and website work across client projects

Schedule



This role starts part-time at approximately 30 hours per week, with the genuine intention to grow into a full-time role within 6–12 months as client work increases and the fit proves strong.



Daily overlap with U.S. Central Time is required because this role collaborates closely with our U.S.-based strategy, design, and development team.



For part-time, we need 3–4 hours of daily overlap with U.S. Central business hours, typically within the 8 AM–12 PM Central Time window.



For candidates in the Philippines, this is usually:



9 PM–1 AM Manila time during U.S. daylight saving time

10 PM–2 AM Manila time during U.S. standard time



When the role grows to full-time, the overlap grows with it. We expect approximately 6 hours of your workday to overlap with U.S. Central business hours.



Please apply only if this schedule is realistic for you long-term — not just during the brave and caffeinated first week.



Pay



Pay starts at $8–10/hour USD, based on experience and portfolio strength.



This will be reviewed after the first 60–90 days, with room to grow as the role expands into full-time. Strong full-time performers are expected to move into the $10/hour+ range as scope, consistency, and ownership increase.



We’re building a long-term creative team, so we’ll prioritize applicants looking for a stable, multi-year home — not short-term project-hopping.



Payment will be made through the agreed method.



How to Apply



We read every application, but we filter carefully for attention to detail.



To be considered, please include all four items below:



Start your application with the word “ONWARDS” so we know you read this far.

Include a link to your portfolio. Your portfolio must clearly mark:

Your 3 best logo or brand identity projects

Your 3 best complete website designs

At least one website example that shows desktop and mobile/responsive thinking

In 2–3 sentences, tell us about one website you designed:

What did the client need?

What design decisions did you make to solve that need?

State your current availability and confirm explicitly that you can work:

3–4 hours daily during U.S. Central business hours now

Approximately 6 hours during U.S. Central business hours when the role becomes full-time



Applications missing any of these four items will not be reviewed.



We’re looking for someone who wants to grow with us for years, not months. If that’s you, we’d love to see your work.



Onwards.

s

s and DMs are answered promptly

15 Hours - Customer Care Elephant

s

title: Accounting Clerk (AR Focus)
description:
About the Role:



We are a dynamic and growing wholesale distribution company specializing in dropship fulfillment in the Sexual Health and Wellness industry. Our mission is to deliver high-quality products and exceptional service to our customers, supported by strong operational and accounting processes.

We are seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Accounting Clerk with a primary focus on Accounts Receivable to support our accounting team. This role combines customer account management, payment processing, credit administration, and general accounting support.



You will work closely with our Accounts Receivable Manager and Controller to help maintain accurate customer accounts, support daily accounting operations, and assist with general ledger activities. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys a variety of accounting responsibilities, is organized, comfortable reviewing financial information, and eager to expand their accounting knowledge.



Key Responsibilities:



Credit Management

• Review customer orders against payment history, outstanding balances, and credit terms.

• Make initial credit decisions regarding order releases and escalate exceptions when necessary.

• Place or release customer accounts from credit hold as appropriate.

Payment Processing

• Accept and process customer credit card payments using internal procedures.

• Communicate with customers regarding declined payments and assist with resolving payment issues.

• Post payments accurately to customer accounts.

Customer Account Support

• Manage and respond to the Accounts Receivable
 inbox.

• Send customer statements and specialized reports upon request.

• Communicate with customers regarding account balances and payment status.

Account Maintenance

• Process customer credit and debit memos.

• Maintain accurate customer account records within the ERP system.

General Ledger Support

• Assist with monthly bank and general ledger account reconciliations.

• Prepare supporting schedules and documentation for month-end close.

• Research and resolve accounting discrepancies.

• Assist with journal entries and other general ledger transactions as assigned.

• Support the Controller with general accounting projects and month-end activities.

Team Support

• Provide backup support to the Accounts Receivable Manager.

• Assist with month-end accounting activities as assigned.

• Assist with special projects and other accounting-related tasks.

• Work with the accounting team to identify opportunities for process improvements and implement more efficient workflows.

• Perform other accounting and administrative duties as assigned.



Qualifications

• 2+ years of experience in Accounts Receivable, bookkeeping, or general accounting.

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

• Experience working with accounting software or ERP systems.

• Strong Microsoft Excel skills.

• Excellent written English communication skills.

• Ability to review financial information and make sound decisions.

• Basic understanding of general ledger accounting and account reconciliations.



Preferred Experience

• Experience supporting a U.S.-based company.

• Reviewing AR aging reports or assisting with credit decisions.

• Supporting month-end close activities.

• Preparing bank or balance sheet account reconciliations.

• Experience working in distribution, wholesale, or product-based businesses.



Working Schedule

This position supports our U.S.-based accounting team and requires working during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

• Monday through Friday

• 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (U.S.)

• Full-time schedule (40 hours per week)

• Reliable attendance during scheduled working hours is required.



Technology Requirements

This is a remote contractor role. The selected candidate must provide their own work equipment and workspace, including:

• A reliable computer capable of running modern accounting and office software.

• A stable high-speed internet connection.

• A quiet and professional work environment suitable for remote work.



Our company will provide access to the necessary software systems; however, hardware such as computers, monitors, and other equipment will not be supplied.



Industry Disclosure

Our company operates in the specialty retail and distribution industry, supplying products that are intended for adult consumers. As a result, some product names, product descriptions, or images encountered in our systems and documents may contain adult-oriented content. Candidates should be comfortable working in a professional environment where such products are part of the business.



What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone seeking a long-term opportunity with a growing company. The ideal candidate is dependable, eager to learn, takes pride in producing accurate work, and enjoys being part of a collaborative accounting team. As our company continues to grow, there will be opportunities to expand your responsibilities and develop your accounting career.



Application Instructions

When applying, please include a short paragraph describing your experience reviewing customer accounts, credit limits, or AR aging to approve or release orders.

Please begin your application with the words "AR Specialist" so we know you reviewed the full job description.

We're looking for an exceptional Virtual Assistant to join our growing team. This isn't a typical VA role—we're looking for someone who enjoys getting involved in all aspects of a fast-growing business and is excited to grow with us.

No two days are the same. One day you may be coordinating sales appointments and managing diaries, the next updating our website, creating documents with AI, organising projects, or helping with marketing and social media.

* Slack

* Trello (or similar project management software)

* AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to improve productivity

* CRM systems and sales administration

* Diary management and scheduling

* Lead allocation and sales team support

Sales Support Responsibilities



* Managing sales representatives' diaries

* Allocating and distributing new leads

* Monitoring appointment schedules

* Ensuring sales administration is accurate and up to date

* Following internal processes and checklists

* Supporting the management team with day-to-day operations

* Liaising confidently with the sales team by phone,
 and Slack



Additional Responsibilities



We're specifically looking for someone with a broad range of skills who is happy to work beyond a traditional VA role, including:



* Updating and maintaining our WordPress website

* Assisting with social media content and scheduling

* Creating documents, presentations and business materials

* Conducting online research

* Assisting with business setup projects

* Using AI to streamline tasks and improve efficiency

* Supporting new business initiatives as they arise

* Helping improve internal systems and processes

* Taking ownership of tasks from start to finish



The Ideal Candidate



You'll be:



* Highly organised with excellent attention to detail

* Proactive and able to work without constant supervision

* A confident communicator with excellent spoken and written English

* Comfortable speaking with the team over the phone and on video calls

* Reliable, trustworthy and professional

* Able to prioritise multiple tasks and meet deadlines

* A quick learner who enjoys solving problems

* Flexible and willing to help wherever needed

Desirable Experience

* Home improvement

* Roofing

* Insulation

* Construction

* Property

* Home services



What We're Looking For



We're not looking for someone who simply completes tasks when asked.

About Us



We're a commercial flooring and tile subcontractor based in California. We work directly with major general contractors on commercial construction projects: schools, retail, healthcare, and life sciences buildings.



This is a real support role on a busy team, not filler admin work. You'll be helping keep active construction projects moving, keeping our Project Executive's inbox under control, and supporting the people who bring in the business. What You'll Do



Submittals & project support





Compile submittal packages (product data sheets, samples, warranty/maintenance docs) for flooring and tile scope

Build and maintain submittal logs across multiple active projects

Track specs, attic stock requirements, and labor packets post-award

Flag conflicts, missing info, or errors in specs and paperwork before they become expensive problems in the field





Executive & inbox support





Help our Project Executive maintain inbox zero — triage, flag priorities, draft responses, and file/track what needs follow-up

Keep on top of deadlines and open items so nothing falls through the cracks

Admin support for our top-performing sales team: organizing leads/contacts, prepping documents, calendar coordination, and other day-to-day admin tasks that keep them focused on selling







What We're Looking For





Fluent written and spoken English (non-negotiable — you'll be corresponding directly with US architects, GCs, and our internal team)

Real experience in construction admin, submittals, contract coordination, or executive/sales support — this is not an entry-level general VA role

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable owning a checklist without being chased

Good judgment — comfortable flagging something as unclear or asking a question rather than guessing and getting it wrong

Able to juggle competing priorities across different people (PM, PX, sales) without dropping the ball

Bonus: familiarity with Procore, submittal logs, or CSI spec formatting

Reliable internet and a setup that supports video calls and real-time collaboration during part of the US Pacific business day







Hiring Process





Resume/profile review

Paid test assignment (~2–3 hours, flat fee paid regardless of outcome) — a realistic work sample covering spec review, quantity math, and a prioritization scenario

Short video interview

Contract start







To Apply



Send your resume along with 2–3 sentences on your experience with construction admin/submittals or executive/sales support work. Please don't apply without direct relevant experience in at least one of those areas — the test assignment will make the gap obvious quickly either way, and we'd rather not waste your time or ours.

title: QA Analyst
description:
osition Summary



The QA Analyst will own the quality assurance process across our Base44 application. You will work closely with product managers, developers, and AI engineers to test new features, identify defects, validate integrations, and improve the overall user experience before releases.



This role requires someone who understands modern AI-powered applications, low-code platforms, API integrations, and end-to-end testing.



Responsibilities



* Develop and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and regression tests.

* Test new Base44 features before every production release.

* Validate AI workflows, prompts, automations, and generated outputs.

* Test role-based permissions across Admin, Care Advisor, Hospital, Provider, and Family portals.

* Verify responsive behavior across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

* Identify UI/UX inconsistencies and usability issues.

* Document bugs with clear reproduction steps, screenshots, and videos.

* Verify bug fixes before deployment.

* Perform smoke, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing.

* Collaborate with developers to troubleshoot production issues.

* Recommend process improvements to increase software quality.



Integrations You’ll Test



* Base44 platform

* Twilio (Voice, SMS, Call Recording, Transcriptions)

* Supabase

* Zapier

*
 workflows

* Authentication and user management

* AI agents and automations

* APIs and webhooks



Required Qualifications



* 2+ years of Quality Assurance experience.

* Hands-on experience testing applications built with Base44.

* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC).

* Experience writing detailed bug reports and test documentation.

* Familiarity with API testing tools .

* Experience testing responsive web applications.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Excellent communication and documentation abilities.

* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced startup environment.



Preferred Qualifications



* Healthcare technology or SaaS experience.

* HIPAA compliance knowledge.

* Experience with Supabase.

* Experience testing AI-powered applications.

* Experience testing Twilio integrations.

* Familiarity with GitHub, Jira, or Linear.

* Experience with automated testing frameworks.



Success Metrics



Within the first 90 days, you will:



* Reduce production bugs through comprehensive regression testing.

* Establish repeatable QA processes for every release.

* Build and maintain a library of reusable test cases.

* Validate all major workflows before deployment.

* Improve overall product quality and release confidence.



Ideal Candidate



You are detail-oriented, curious, and enjoy breaking software before users do. You think like an end user, communicate clearly with developers, and take ownership of software quality. Startup experience and a proactive mindset are highly valued.



How to Apply



Please include:



* Resume

* Portfolio or examples of applications you’ve tested

* Details of your Base44 experience

* Experience with AI applications, integrations

* Availability and hourly rate

title: Supply Chain & Production Planning Analyst
description:
Position Overview



We are seeking a highly organized and analytical Supply Chain & Production Planning Analyst to support the end-to-end management of our global supply chain across multiple consumer brands, products, and international manufacturing partners. This role is responsible for coordinating production planning, monitoring inventory levels, managing purchase orders, and ensuring products move efficiently from factory to warehouse.



The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, confident working with data, and experienced in communicating with factories, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and internal teams to maintain accurate inventory and production timelines.



Key Responsibilities



Production Planning & Inventory Management



* Maintain production plans based on sales trends, forecasts, inventory levels, and lead times.

* Monitor inventory across multiple brands and warehouses to ensure optimal stock levels.

* Analyze sales performance and inventory data to recommend production and replenishment plans.

* Identify potential inventory shortages or excess inventory and recommend corrective actions.

* Prepare and distribute weekly inventory reports, including:



  * Inventory updates

  * New Item Tracker

  * Other inventory reporting as required



Purchase Order & Logistics Coordination



* Create and maintain purchase orders within QuickBooks.

* Coordinate shipments with freight forwarders to ensure timely movement of goods.

title: Real Estate Video Editor
description:
Role Overview: Full Time Position | $4.50/hr room for negotiation | 9am-5pm EST



We are looking for a world class Video Editor to lead the post-production for our rapidly growing real estate YouTube channel. You won’t just be cutting clips; you will be responsible for crafting 10-20 minute "Masterclass" style relocation guides, home tours, and market updates designed to turn viewers into leads.



You must be an expert in retention based editing, knowing exactly when to use B-roll, zoom cuts, and sound effects to keep a viewer engaged for 15+ minutes. You will also be responsible for "mining" our long form content to create high impact, viral style Shorts/Reels.



Key Responsibilities

1. Long Form Mastery: Edit 3 high quality long form videos (10–20 mins) per week. This includes color grading, audio leveling (cleaning up "wind" or "echo" from field recordings), and advanced storytelling.

2. Short Form Distribution: Extract and edit a minimum of 5 engaging Shorts/TikToks per week. These must feature "Alex Hormozi style" captions, dynamic zooms, and high energy pacing.

3. Engagement First Editing: Implement "Pattern Interrupts" (B-roll, text overlays, sound design) every 5–10 seconds to maintain high Average View Duration (AVD).

4. Green Screen Integration: Seamlessly integrate Will's talking head footage with property B-roll, Google Earth maps, and market data graphics.

5. Asset Management: Sourcing high quality stock footage, music, and sound effects that match our "Authentic, grounded, yet premium" brand voice.



Technical Requirements

1. Software: Expert level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve. Experience with After Effects for custom motion graphics is a major plus.

2. Short Form Tools: Mastery of CapCut or similar for fast paced social media editing.

3. AI Integration: Familiarity with AI tools (Descript/Opus Pro/RunwayML) to maximize efficiency.

4. Real Estate Intuition: Ability to distinguish between "boring house footage" and "lifestyle B-roll" that sells the neighborhood, not just the kitchen.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Your success in this role will be measured by:

1. Average View Duration (AVD): Can you keep people watching past the 50% mark?

2. Click Through Rate (CTR) Collaboration: Working with our Digital Marketing Director to ensure the "hook" of the video matches the promise of the thumbnail.

3. Inbound Leads: Quality editing that builds trust and prompts viewers to click the "Contact Us" links.



Who You Are

1. You are a Storyteller first and an editor second.

2. You are obsessed with YouTube analytics and understand why a viewer clicks away.

3. You don't need "step by step" instructions; you can take a raw 30 minute Will rant and find the "Gold" that belongs in the final cut.

4. You are organized and can handle a high volume workflow (8 total deliverables per week).

title: Retention Manager / Subscription Data Analyst — 8-Figure Supplement Brand
description:
We are looking for a highly analytical Retention Manager / Subscription Data Analyst to own customer retention, churn reduction, and LTV growth for an 8-figure supplement brand.



This person will not be responsible for making ads, building funnels, or writing copy. Their job is to deeply understand our subscription data, find the leaks in our cohorts, and create clear strategies to keep customers longer — especially past month three.



The main goal of this role is simple: ????Increase LTV, reduce churn, and improve the LTV:CAC ratio.



Responsibilities:

- Reviewing cohort data to understand month 1, month 2, month 3, and month 4+ retention.

- Working with the
/SMS team to develop post-purchase flows that educate customers, increase product usage, reduce buyer’s remorse, and improve rebill rates.

- Creating feedback surveys to understand why customers cancel, refund, or stop engaging with the product.

- Turning customer feedback and cohort data into actionable retention strategies.

- Monitoring key subscription metrics daily, weekly, and monthly.

- Working with the customer support team to identify common cancellation reasons, refund reasons, product complaints, - confusion points, and opportunities to improve the customer experience.

- Helping the team understand which customers, offers, and angles create the highest-quality subscribers.

- Building retention reports, dashboards, and clear recommendations for leadership.



Key Metrics You Will Own:

You should be comfortable tracking and improving:

- Month 1 retention

- Month 2 retention

- Month 3 retention

- Month 4+ retention

- Subscription take rate

- Rebill success rate

- Failed payment rate

- Churn rate

- Refund rate

- Chargeback rate

- LTV

- LTV:CAC ratio

- CAC payback window

- Customer cohort performance

- Retention by offer

- Retention by marketing angle

- Retention by funnel

- Retention by product bundle

- Retention by customer segment



Must-Have Experience: You must have:

- Experience working with an 8-figure ecommerce brand.

- Experience working with a supplement brand.

- Strong understanding of subscription ecommerce and recurring revenue models.

- Strong understanding of LTV:CAC, contribution margin, cohort retention, churn, and CAC payback.

- Proven experience reducing churn and increasing customer LTV.

- Experience analyzing retention data and turning it into clear action.

- Experience working with Shopify.

- Ability to work closely with
/SMS, customer support, media buying, CRO, and operations teams.

- Strong understanding of post-purchase education, customer onboarding, cancellation flows, and save strategies.

- Ability to create structured hypotheses, prioritize retention tests, and clearly track outcomes.



Nice to Have:

- Experience with Checkout Champ.

- Experience with Recharge, Skio, Stay AI, Loop, or other subscription management platforms.

- Experience with Klaviyo or similar
/SMS platforms.

- Experience with direct response supplement offers.

- Experience improving rebill approval rates and failed payment recovery.

- Experience with customer surveys, cancellation surveys, and voice-of-customer analysis.

- Experience building retention dashboards and reporting systems.



What Success Looks Like: You will be successful in this role if you can:

- Clearly identify where the biggest retention leaks are.

- Improve month 1, month 2, and month 3 retention.

- Help customers understand the product better after purchase.

- Reduce preventable cancellations and refunds.

- Improve failed payment recovery.

- Help us understand which front-end offers and marketing angles bring in the highest-LTV customers.

- Create a repeatable system for testing retention improvements.

- Turn retention data into clear strategies that increase profit.



Who This Role Is Not For:  

This is not a generic
 marketing role.



This is not a customer support role.



This is not a media buying or funnel-building role.



We need someone who can look at subscription data, find the leaks, understand why customers are churning, and create a clear plan to improve retention.



If you only think about open rates, click rates, or surface-level
 metrics, this is not the right role.

We need someone who thinks in terms of: Cohorts, churn, LTV, CAC payback, rebill rates, customer education, offer quality, and subscription profitability.

title: Customer Service Representative (Airbnb / Short-Term Rentals - Evening Shift, Remote)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Nomad Equity is a U.S.-based short-term rental management company managing 49 vacation rental homes across California, Texas, Hawaii, Oregon, and beyond. Our mission is to deliver an exceptional guest experience while operating high-quality properties for our homeowners.



We're hiring a Customer Service Representative to join our remote team. This role goes beyond guest messaging: you'll also handle urgent maintenance and supply issues as they come up, and keep open maintenance tasks moving forward until they're done.



If you like being the person who actually gets things FIXED - not just the person who answers messages - this job was written for you.



WORK SCHEDULE



THIS IS AN EVENING / OVERNIGHT SHIFT covering U.S. Pacific Time.



You will work one of the following shifts (assigned based on coverage needs and your preference):

- Monday - Friday, 5:00 PM - 1:00 AM PST, or

- Monday - Friday, 1:00 AM - 9:00 AM PST



For applicants in the Philippines, these correspond to roughly 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM or 4:00 PM - 12:00 midnight Manila time.



If you cannot reliably commit to evening or overnight U.S. Pacific hours long-term, please do not apply.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Respond quickly to guests across our portfolio - pre-arrival questions, check-in help, and issues during the stay

- Handle urgent maintenance and supply escalations: coordinate the right vendor or handyman, keep the guest informed, and follow through until the issue is confirmed resolved

- Keep open maintenance tasks moving forward - chase vendors, update statuses, and escalate anything that's blocked

- Respond quickly to vendors and cleaners and coordinate with them via WhatsApp

- Post an end-of-shift summary and hand off cleanly to your shift partner



REQUIREMENTS



- Minimum 1 year experience working with Airbnb, VRBO, or another short-term rental platform (REQUIRED)

- Excellent written and verbal English (non-negotiable)

- Ability to use project management tools like Monday.com, ClickUp, Asana, email, etc.

- Experience coordinating vendors, maintenance, or field work is a big plus

- Strong follow-through - you close loops without being reminded

- Calm and professional under pressure, able to juggle multiple conversations at once

- Ability to reliably work an evening or overnight U.S. Pacific shift long-term (HARD REQUIREMENT)

- Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, and a working phone for WhatsApp



COMPENSATION



- Rate: $5-$8 USD per hour, depending on experience

- Payment cadence: Biweekly, via Wise / Relay ACH

- 13th-month pay: Yes (paid in December)

- Paid time off: Earned starting after 6-month tenure

- Performance reviews: Every 6 months with rate adjustment opportunity

- Long-term, stable position with a growing company and a real team



HOW TO APPLY



To apply, please visit NomadEquity.com/Careers and select the Airbnb CSR role.



You'll fill out a short application and then complete a brief AI screening interview right in your browser (about 10-15 minutes -- you'll need a webcam, a microphone, and a quiet space). You can complete it at your own convenience.

title: Social Media Coordinator/Community Manager
description:
Purpose 

The Offshore Social Media Coordinator / Community Manager is responsible for scheduling, publishing, monitoring, organizing, and reporting on approved Alarmed Media LLC content across assigned social platforms. This role helps turn content into audience insight by tracking performance, monitoring comments and direct messages, identifying audience questions, and escalating sensitive items. This is not a clinical role and does not provide therapy, diagnosis, crisis counseling, or individualized treatment advice. 



Key Performance Indicators and Reporting 

- Publish or schedule at least 95% of approved posts on time according to the assigned content calendar. 

- Maintain 100% compliance with the approval workflow by posting only approved content, captions, links, hashtags, and platform versions. 

- Review assigned platforms, comments, mentions, and direct messages at least twice per business day or according to the assigned monitoring schedule. 

- Identify at least 10 strong comment-reply video opportunities weekly and add them to the content tracker. 

- Capture at least 25 audience questions, pain points, objections, or recurring themes monthly for content planning. 

- Submit weekly analytics reports on time at least 95% of the time and monthly analytics reports on time 100% of the time. 

- Track every posted video with platform, posting date, caption, link, status, views, engagement, comments, shares, saves, follower change, and other available metrics. 

- Maintain zero unauthorized posts, wrong-version posts, public PHI disclosures, public treatment-relationship confirmations, clinical advice responses, or unapproved crisis responses. 

- Escalate urgent, clinical, privacy, legal, complaint, crisis, OAC-related, or reputation-risk items immediately according to the escalation process. 

- Complete at least one social workflow, analytics, response-template, tracking, or scheduling-process improvement quarterly. 

- Upon achieving these key performance indicators, the supervisor will meet with the contractor to review progress and collaborate on establishing new performance goals that reflect continued growth, quality, and accountability. 



Core Competencies 

- Demonstrate strong social media scheduling, platform management, caption adaptation, community monitoring, and analytics tracking skill. 

- Demonstrate professional judgment, emotional maturity, and clear boundaries when reviewing comments and messages from vulnerable or distressed individuals. 

- Demonstrate strong organization, attention to detail, file/link accuracy, and deadline follow-through. 

- Demonstrate the ability to identify audience language, recurring questions, and content opportunities from comments and platform performance. 

- Demonstrate strict confidentiality and appropriate escalation of sensitive information. 



Core Responsibilities 

– These duties may vary depending on project assignments and Company needs. 

- Schedule and publish approved content across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts,
, LinkedIn, and other assigned platforms. 

- Confirm that the correct video version, caption, title, thumbnail, hashtags, links, and platform settings are used before posting. 

- Adapt captions and titles for each platform while preserving accuracy, tone, and approved messaging. 

- Monitor comments, direct messages, mentions, shares, tags, and audience engagement according to assigned schedules. 

- Organize audience questions, objections, pain points, and story ideas by theme for future content planning. 

- Identify comments that may become strong reply videos, FAQs, carousels, podcast topics, or long-form video topics. 

- Maintain and update social media performance trackers, dashboards, content logs, and platform links. 

- Escalate crisis comments, clinical questions, legal complaints, privacy concerns, OAC-related questions, spam, threats, harassment, or reputation issues according to approved rules. 

- Use only approved response templates and do not provide clinical advice, diagnosis, treatment recommendations, crisis counseling, or individualized guidance. 

- Coordinate with the Content Producer and Video Editor to confirm posting readiness and resolve platform or asset issues. 

- Perform other duties as assigned commensurate with the position duties. 

- Adhere to all Alarmed Media LLC policies, confidentiality rules, contractor agreements, and platform-access standards. 



Required Qualifications 

- 1–3+ years of experience managing or supporting social media accounts, content calendars, posting schedules, community management, or analytics preferred. 

- Experience with TikTok, Instagram, YouTube,
, LinkedIn, and/or scheduling tools preferred. 

- Strong written English and ability to adapt captions, titles, comments, and reporting summaries professionally. 

- Experience working with personal brands, educational content, healthcare, mental health, coaching, nonprofits, or mission-driven organizations preferred. 

- Strong spreadsheet, tracking, and reporting skills required. 

- Reliable internet access, secure computer practices, and ability to work independently in a remote/offshore environment required.

title: Graphic Designer for a 30-Year Volleyball Brand
description:
Graphic Designer for a 30-Year Volleyball Brand (Pure Design, No Ads Knowledge Needed)



TYPE OF WORK: Any

WAGE / SALARY: Negotiable, you name your price

HOURS PER WEEK: 30



JOB OVERVIEW



All Volleyball has been selling to the U.S. volleyball community for over 30 years. Shoes, apparel, balls, and team gear, for athletes, clubs, and fans across the country. Real products, real customers, real budgets behind the creative.



The company runs on a Filipino team. That was a hiring decision, not a cost decision. Our designers, editors, and marketing staff are Filipino, and several of them have been with us for years. They stayed because the briefs are clear, the pay arrives when we say it will, and nobody here gets treated as disposable for being remote.



We are opening our search for the next designer to join them, and we want to hear from you before we d
 anything about titles, hours, or contracts.



WHY WE THINK YOU WILL WANT THIS



Most design jobs on this site ask you to be four people at once. Designer, media buyer, video editor, strategist, all for one rate. We are doing the opposite.



You do not need to know Meta ads. You do not need to understand hook rates, CTR, CPA, or funnels, and we will never ask you about them. We have people for that already. What we need from you is design, done at a level most companies never get near.



Here is what the job actually looks like:



1 - You get real products to work with. Volleyball shoes, jerseys, balls, team gear, photographed properly, waiting for someone to make them look like something



2 - Your work ships. It goes out to a national audience of athletes and clubs who buy from us, not into a folder nobody opens



3 - You name your price. We do not post a rate because we do not pay a rate, we pay a person. Tell us what you are worth 

and back it up with your work



4 - You get paid through Wise, quickly, without chasing anyone. Ask any Filipino freelancer how rare that is



5 - Do well and you earn more. The people who deliver here have watched their rates climb, because we would rather pay someone good than go looking for someone new



6 - You talk directly to our marketing manager in Slack. No account managers, no layers, no telephone game between you and the person who d



There is creative freedom here, and there is also direction, which means you will never be guessing what we want and you will never be micromanaged while you do it.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Taste, mostly. The rest can be taught.



1 - A strong eye for layout, type, color, hierarchy, and spacing



2 - Real fluency in Figma, Photoshop, or Illustrator. One of them, used well, is enough



3 - Comfort with AI tools like Photoshop AI, Firefly, or Midjourney to move faster



4 - Someone who can look at a raw product photo on a white background and already see the finished piece



5 - Someone who knows why one layout breathes and another feels cramped, and fixes it without being asked



6 - You take feedback and revise without ego



7 - Strong English and clear written communication



Experience with sports or performance brands helps. We do not require it. If your portfolio has one piece in it that you are quietly proud of, we want to see that piece.



WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY



We will save you the time. If you send the same template to forty job posts, if your portfolio is stock mockups, or if you need someone standing over you to get work finished, we are not going to be a fit. Everyone else, keep reading.



HOW TO APPLY



This part is short on purpose. We want to see your work before we ask anything else of you.



Send us:



1 - A short introduction about yourself and your background as a designer



2 - Your portfolio. A link, a PDF, a Google Drive folder, whatever you already have. Do not build something new for us



3 - The one piece in it you are most proud of, and one sentence on why



4 - The tools you work in, including any AI tools



5 - What you would want to be paid. Monthly, hourly, or per project. Be direct. We will not be offended, and we will not lowball you for answering honestly



That is the whole application. No test, no spec work, no assignment.



If we like what we see, we will reach out personally, tell you exactly what the work and the money look like, and take it from there. Everyone who applies with a real portfolio and a real rate gets looked at by a person, not a filter.



BEFORE YOU GO



We have teammates who have been here five, six, and seven years. 



That does not happen by a
. It happens because we are honest about what we expect, we pay on time, and we treat skilled people like the asset they are.



If you are a designer who has been waiting for a brand that cares about the design itself, and a team of Filipinos who take real pride in their craft, send us your work. We read every application.



SKILL REQUIREMENT: Design, Graphic Design, Photoshop
